<h3 id="walletobjectsflightclassupdate-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|resourceId|path|string|true|The unique identifier for a class. This ID must be unique across all classes from an issuer. This value should follow the format issuer ID. identifier where the former is issued by Google and latter is chosen by you. Your unique identifier should only include alphanumeric characters, '.', '_', or '-'.|
|$.xgafv|query|string|false|V1 error format.|
|access_token|query|string|false|OAuth access token.|
|alt|query|string|false|Data format for response.|
|callback|query|string|false|JSONP|
|fields|query|string|false|Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response.|
|key|query|string|false|API key. Your API key identifies your project and provides you with API access, quota, and reports. Required unless you provide an OAuth 2.0 token.|
|oauth_token|query|string|false|OAuth 2.0 token for the current user.|
|prettyPrint|query|boolean|false|Returns response with indentations and line breaks.|
|quotaUser|query|string|false|Available to use for quota purposes for server-side applications. Can be any arbitrary string assigned to a user, but should not exceed 40 characters.|
|upload_protocol|query|string|false|Upload protocol for media (e.g. "raw", "multipart").|
|uploadType|query|string|false|Legacy upload protocol for media (e.g. "media", "multipart").|
|body|body|[FlightClass](#schemaflightclass)|false|none|
|» allowMultipleUsersPerObject|body|boolean|false|Deprecated. Use `multipleDevicesAndHoldersAllowedStatus` instead.|
|» boardingAndSeatingPolicy|body|[BoardingAndSeatingPolicy](#schemaboardingandseatingpolicy)|false|Policies for boarding and seating. These will inform which labels will be shown to users.|
|» callbackOptions|body|[CallbackOptions](#schemacallbackoptions)|false|Callback options to be used to call the issuer back for every save/delete of an object for this class by the end-user. All objects of this class are eligible for the callback.|
|» classTemplateInfo|body|[ClassTemplateInfo](#schemaclasstemplateinfo)|false|Template information about how the class should be displayed. If unset, Google will fallback to a default set of fields to display.|
|» countryCode|body|string|false|Country code used to display the card's country (when the user is not in that country), as well as to display localized content when content is not available in the user's locale.|
|» destination|body|[AirportInfo](#schemaairportinfo)|false|Required. Destination airport.|
|» enableSmartTap|body|boolean|false|Identifies whether this class supports Smart Tap. The `redemptionIssuers` and object level `smartTapRedemptionLevel` fields must also be set up correctly in order for a pass to support Smart Tap.|
|» flightHeader|body|[FlightHeader](#schemaflightheader)|false|Required. Information about the flight carrier and number.|
|» flightStatus|body|string|false|Status of this flight. If unset, Google will compute status based on data from other sources, such as FlightStats, etc. Note: Google-computed status will not be returned in API responses.|
|» heroImage|body|[Image](#schemaimage)|false|Optional banner image displayed on the front of the card. If none is present, nothing will be displayed. The image will display at 100% width.|
|» hexBackgroundColor|body|string|false|The background color for the card. If not set the dominant color of the hero image is used, and if no hero image is set, the dominant color of the logo is used. The format is #rrggbb where rrggbb is a hex RGB triplet, such as `#ffcc00`. You can also use the shorthand version of the RGB triplet which is #rgb, such as `#fc0`.|
|» homepageUri|body|[Uri](#schemauri)|false|The URI of your application's home page. Populating the URI in this field results in the exact same behavior as populating an URI in linksModuleData (when an object is rendered, a link to the homepage is shown in what would usually be thought of as the linksModuleData section of the object).|
|» id|body|string|false|Required. The unique identifier for a class. This ID must be unique across all classes from an issuer. This value should follow the format issuer ID. identifier where the former is issued by Google and latter is chosen by you. Your unique identifier should only include alphanumeric characters, '.', '_', or '-'.|
|» imageModulesData|body|[[ImageModuleData](#schemaimagemoduledata)]|false|Image module data. The maximum number of these fields displayed is 1 from object level and 1 for class object level.|
|» infoModuleData|body|[InfoModuleData](#schemainfomoduledata)|false|Deprecated. Use textModulesData instead.|
|» issuerName|body|string|false|Required. The issuer name. Recommended maximum length is 20 characters to ensure full string is displayed on smaller screens.|
|» kind|body|string|false|Identifies what kind of resource this is. Value: the fixed string `"walletobjects#flightClass"`.|
|» languageOverride|body|string|false|If this field is present, boarding passes served to a user's device will always be in this language. Represents the BCP 47 language tag. Example values are "en-US", "en-GB", "de", or "de-AT".|
|» linksModuleData|body|[LinksModuleData](#schemalinksmoduledata)|false|Links module data. If links module data is also defined on the object, both will be displayed.|
|» localBoardingDateTime|body|string|false|The boarding time as it would be printed on the boarding pass. This is an ISO 8601 extended format date/time without an offset. Time may be specified up to millisecond precision. eg: `2027-03-05T06:30:00` This should be the local date/time at the airport (not a UTC time). Google will reject the request if UTC offset is provided. Time zones will be calculated by Google based on departure airport. If this is not set, Google will set it based on data from other sources.|
|» localEstimatedOrActualArrivalDateTime|body|string|false|The estimated time the aircraft plans to reach the destination gate (not the runway) or the actual time it reached the gate. This field should be set if at least one of the below is true: - It differs from the scheduled time. Google will use it to calculate the delay. - The aircraft already arrived at the gate. Google will use it to inform the user that the flight has arrived at the gate. This is an ISO 8601 extended format date/time without an offset. Time may be specified up to millisecond precision. eg: `2027-03-05T06:30:00` This should be the local date/time at the airport (not a UTC time). Google will reject the request if UTC offset is provided. Time zones will be calculated by Google based on arrival airport. If this is not set, Google will set it based on data from other sources.|
|» localEstimatedOrActualDepartureDateTime|body|string|false|The estimated time the aircraft plans to pull from the gate or the actual time the aircraft already pulled from the gate. Note: This is not the runway time. This field should be set if at least one of the below is true: - It differs from the scheduled time. Google will use it to calculate the delay. - The aircraft already pulled from the gate. Google will use it to inform the user when the flight actually departed. This is an ISO 8601 extended format date/time without an offset. Time may be specified up to millisecond precision. eg: `2027-03-05T06:30:00` This should be the local date/time at the airport (not a UTC time). Google will reject the request if UTC offset is provided. Time zones will be calculated by Google based on departure airport. If this is not set, Google will set it based on data from other sources.|
|» localGateClosingDateTime|body|string|false|The gate closing time as it would be printed on the boarding pass. Do not set this field if you do not want to print it in the boarding pass. This is an ISO 8601 extended format date/time without an offset. Time may be specified up to millisecond precision. eg: `2027-03-05T06:30:00` This should be the local date/time at the airport (not a UTC time). Google will reject the request if UTC offset is provided. Time zones will be calculated by Google based on departure airport.|
|» localScheduledArrivalDateTime|body|string|false|The scheduled time the aircraft plans to reach the destination gate (not the runway). Note: This field should not change too close to the flight time. For updates to departure times (delays, etc), please set `localEstimatedOrActualArrivalDateTime`. This is an ISO 8601 extended format date/time without an offset. Time may be specified up to millisecond precision. eg: `2027-03-05T06:30:00` This should be the local date/time at the airport (not a UTC time). Google will reject the request if UTC offset is provided. Time zones will be calculated by Google based on arrival airport. If this is not set, Google will set it based on data from other sources.|
|» localScheduledDepartureDateTime|body|string|false|Required. The scheduled date and time when the aircraft is expected to depart the gate (not the runway) Note: This field should not change too close to the departure time. For updates to departure times (delays, etc), please set `localEstimatedOrActualDepartureDateTime`. This is an ISO 8601 extended format date/time without an offset. Time may be specified up to millisecond precision. eg: `2027-03-05T06:30:00` This should be the local date/time at the airport (not a UTC time). Google will reject the request if UTC offset is provided. Time zones will be calculated by Google based on departure airport.|
|» localizedIssuerName|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|Translated strings for the issuer_name. Recommended maximum length is 20 characters to ensure full string is displayed on smaller screens.|
|» locations|body|[[LatLongPoint](#schemalatlongpoint)]|false|Note: This field is currently not supported to trigger geo notifications.|
|» messages|body|[[Message](#schemamessage)]|false|An array of messages displayed in the app. All users of this object will receive its associated messages. The maximum number of these fields is 10.|
|» multipleDevicesAndHoldersAllowedStatus|body|string|false|Identifies whether multiple users and devices will save the same object referencing this class.|
|» origin|body|[AirportInfo](#schemaairportinfo)|false|Required. Origin airport.|
|» redemptionIssuers|body|[string(int64)]|false|Identifies which redemption issuers can redeem the pass over Smart Tap. Redemption issuers are identified by their issuer ID. Redemption issuers must have at least one Smart Tap key configured. The `enableSmartTap` and object level `smartTapRedemptionLevel` fields must also be set up correctly in order for a pass to support Smart Tap.|
|» review|body|[Review](#schemareview)|false|The review comments set by the platform when a class is marked `approved` or `rejected`.|
|» reviewStatus|body|string|false|Required. The status of the class. This field can be set to `draft` or `underReview` using the insert, patch, or update API calls. Once the review state is changed from `draft` it may not be changed back to `draft`. You should keep this field to `draft` when the class is under development. A `draft` class cannot be used to create any object. You should set this field to `underReview` when you believe the class is ready for use. The platform will automatically set this field to `approved` and it can be immediately used to create or migrate objects. When updating an already `approved` class you should keep setting this field to `underReview`.|
|» securityAnimation|body|[SecurityAnimation](#schemasecurityanimation)|false|Optional information about the security animation. If this is set a security animation will be rendered on pass details.|
|» textModulesData|body|[[TextModuleData](#schematextmoduledata)]|false|Text module data. If text module data is also defined on the class, both will be displayed. The maximum number of these fields displayed is 10 from the object and 10 from the class.|
|» version|body|string(int64)|false|Deprecated|
|» viewUnlockRequirement|body|string|false|View Unlock Requirement options for the boarding pass.|
|» wordMark|body|[Image](#schemaimage)|false|Deprecated.|

<h3 id="walletobjectsflightclasspatch-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|resourceId|path|string|true|The unique identifier for a class. This ID must be unique across all classes from an issuer. This value should follow the format issuer ID. identifier where the former is issued by Google and latter is chosen by you. Your unique identifier should only include alphanumeric characters, '.', '_', or '-'.|
|$.xgafv|query|string|false|V1 error format.|
|access_token|query|string|false|OAuth access token.|
|alt|query|string|false|Data format for response.|
|callback|query|string|false|JSONP|
|fields|query|string|false|Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response.|
|key|query|string|false|API key. Your API key identifies your project and provides you with API access, quota, and reports. Required unless you provide an OAuth 2.0 token.|
|oauth_token|query|string|false|OAuth 2.0 token for the current user.|
|prettyPrint|query|boolean|false|Returns response with indentations and line breaks.|
|quotaUser|query|string|false|Available to use for quota purposes for server-side applications. Can be any arbitrary string assigned to a user, but should not exceed 40 characters.|
|upload_protocol|query|string|false|Upload protocol for media (e.g. "raw", "multipart").|
|uploadType|query|string|false|Legacy upload protocol for media (e.g. "media", "multipart").|
|body|body|[FlightClass](#schemaflightclass)|false|none|
|» allowMultipleUsersPerObject|body|boolean|false|Deprecated. Use `multipleDevicesAndHoldersAllowedStatus` instead.|
|» boardingAndSeatingPolicy|body|[BoardingAndSeatingPolicy](#schemaboardingandseatingpolicy)|false|Policies for boarding and seating. These will inform which labels will be shown to users.|
|» callbackOptions|body|[CallbackOptions](#schemacallbackoptions)|false|Callback options to be used to call the issuer back for every save/delete of an object for this class by the end-user. All objects of this class are eligible for the callback.|
|» classTemplateInfo|body|[ClassTemplateInfo](#schemaclasstemplateinfo)|false|Template information about how the class should be displayed. If unset, Google will fallback to a default set of fields to display.|
|» countryCode|body|string|false|Country code used to display the card's country (when the user is not in that country), as well as to display localized content when content is not available in the user's locale.|
|» destination|body|[AirportInfo](#schemaairportinfo)|false|Required. Destination airport.|
|» enableSmartTap|body|boolean|false|Identifies whether this class supports Smart Tap. The `redemptionIssuers` and object level `smartTapRedemptionLevel` fields must also be set up correctly in order for a pass to support Smart Tap.|
|» flightHeader|body|[FlightHeader](#schemaflightheader)|false|Required. Information about the flight carrier and number.|
|» flightStatus|body|string|false|Status of this flight. If unset, Google will compute status based on data from other sources, such as FlightStats, etc. Note: Google-computed status will not be returned in API responses.|
|» heroImage|body|[Image](#schemaimage)|false|Optional banner image displayed on the front of the card. If none is present, nothing will be displayed. The image will display at 100% width.|
|» hexBackgroundColor|body|string|false|The background color for the card. If not set the dominant color of the hero image is used, and if no hero image is set, the dominant color of the logo is used. The format is #rrggbb where rrggbb is a hex RGB triplet, such as `#ffcc00`. You can also use the shorthand version of the RGB triplet which is #rgb, such as `#fc0`.|
|» homepageUri|body|[Uri](#schemauri)|false|The URI of your application's home page. Populating the URI in this field results in the exact same behavior as populating an URI in linksModuleData (when an object is rendered, a link to the homepage is shown in what would usually be thought of as the linksModuleData section of the object).|
|» id|body|string|false|Required. The unique identifier for a class. This ID must be unique across all classes from an issuer. This value should follow the format issuer ID. identifier where the former is issued by Google and latter is chosen by you. Your unique identifier should only include alphanumeric characters, '.', '_', or '-'.|
|» imageModulesData|body|[[ImageModuleData](#schemaimagemoduledata)]|false|Image module data. The maximum number of these fields displayed is 1 from object level and 1 for class object level.|
|» infoModuleData|body|[InfoModuleData](#schemainfomoduledata)|false|Deprecated. Use textModulesData instead.|
|» issuerName|body|string|false|Required. The issuer name. Recommended maximum length is 20 characters to ensure full string is displayed on smaller screens.|
|» kind|body|string|false|Identifies what kind of resource this is. Value: the fixed string `"walletobjects#flightClass"`.|
|» languageOverride|body|string|false|If this field is present, boarding passes served to a user's device will always be in this language. Represents the BCP 47 language tag. Example values are "en-US", "en-GB", "de", or "de-AT".|
|» linksModuleData|body|[LinksModuleData](#schemalinksmoduledata)|false|Links module data. If links module data is also defined on the object, both will be displayed.|
|» localBoardingDateTime|body|string|false|The boarding time as it would be printed on the boarding pass. This is an ISO 8601 extended format date/time without an offset. Time may be specified up to millisecond precision. eg: `2027-03-05T06:30:00` This should be the local date/time at the airport (not a UTC time). Google will reject the request if UTC offset is provided. Time zones will be calculated by Google based on departure airport. If this is not set, Google will set it based on data from other sources.|
|» localEstimatedOrActualArrivalDateTime|body|string|false|The estimated time the aircraft plans to reach the destination gate (not the runway) or the actual time it reached the gate. This field should be set if at least one of the below is true: - It differs from the scheduled time. Google will use it to calculate the delay. - The aircraft already arrived at the gate. Google will use it to inform the user that the flight has arrived at the gate. This is an ISO 8601 extended format date/time without an offset. Time may be specified up to millisecond precision. eg: `2027-03-05T06:30:00` This should be the local date/time at the airport (not a UTC time). Google will reject the request if UTC offset is provided. Time zones will be calculated by Google based on arrival airport. If this is not set, Google will set it based on data from other sources.|
|» localEstimatedOrActualDepartureDateTime|body|string|false|The estimated time the aircraft plans to pull from the gate or the actual time the aircraft already pulled from the gate. Note: This is not the runway time. This field should be set if at least one of the below is true: - It differs from the scheduled time. Google will use it to calculate the delay. - The aircraft already pulled from the gate. Google will use it to inform the user when the flight actually departed. This is an ISO 8601 extended format date/time without an offset. Time may be specified up to millisecond precision. eg: `2027-03-05T06:30:00` This should be the local date/time at the airport (not a UTC time). Google will reject the request if UTC offset is provided. Time zones will be calculated by Google based on departure airport. If this is not set, Google will set it based on data from other sources.|
|» localGateClosingDateTime|body|string|false|The gate closing time as it would be printed on the boarding pass. Do not set this field if you do not want to print it in the boarding pass. This is an ISO 8601 extended format date/time without an offset. Time may be specified up to millisecond precision. eg: `2027-03-05T06:30:00` This should be the local date/time at the airport (not a UTC time). Google will reject the request if UTC offset is provided. Time zones will be calculated by Google based on departure airport.|
|» localScheduledArrivalDateTime|body|string|false|The scheduled time the aircraft plans to reach the destination gate (not the runway). Note: This field should not change too close to the flight time. For updates to departure times (delays, etc), please set `localEstimatedOrActualArrivalDateTime`. This is an ISO 8601 extended format date/time without an offset. Time may be specified up to millisecond precision. eg: `2027-03-05T06:30:00` This should be the local date/time at the airport (not a UTC time). Google will reject the request if UTC offset is provided. Time zones will be calculated by Google based on arrival airport. If this is not set, Google will set it based on data from other sources.|
|» localScheduledDepartureDateTime|body|string|false|Required. The scheduled date and time when the aircraft is expected to depart the gate (not the runway) Note: This field should not change too close to the departure time. For updates to departure times (delays, etc), please set `localEstimatedOrActualDepartureDateTime`. This is an ISO 8601 extended format date/time without an offset. Time may be specified up to millisecond precision. eg: `2027-03-05T06:30:00` This should be the local date/time at the airport (not a UTC time). Google will reject the request if UTC offset is provided. Time zones will be calculated by Google based on departure airport.|
|» localizedIssuerName|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|Translated strings for the issuer_name. Recommended maximum length is 20 characters to ensure full string is displayed on smaller screens.|
|» locations|body|[[LatLongPoint](#schemalatlongpoint)]|false|Note: This field is currently not supported to trigger geo notifications.|
|» messages|body|[[Message](#schemamessage)]|false|An array of messages displayed in the app. All users of this object will receive its associated messages. The maximum number of these fields is 10.|
|» multipleDevicesAndHoldersAllowedStatus|body|string|false|Identifies whether multiple users and devices will save the same object referencing this class.|
|» origin|body|[AirportInfo](#schemaairportinfo)|false|Required. Origin airport.|
|» redemptionIssuers|body|[string(int64)]|false|Identifies which redemption issuers can redeem the pass over Smart Tap. Redemption issuers are identified by their issuer ID. Redemption issuers must have at least one Smart Tap key configured. The `enableSmartTap` and object level `smartTapRedemptionLevel` fields must also be set up correctly in order for a pass to support Smart Tap.|
|» review|body|[Review](#schemareview)|false|The review comments set by the platform when a class is marked `approved` or `rejected`.|
|» reviewStatus|body|string|false|Required. The status of the class. This field can be set to `draft` or `underReview` using the insert, patch, or update API calls. Once the review state is changed from `draft` it may not be changed back to `draft`. You should keep this field to `draft` when the class is under development. A `draft` class cannot be used to create any object. You should set this field to `underReview` when you believe the class is ready for use. The platform will automatically set this field to `approved` and it can be immediately used to create or migrate objects. When updating an already `approved` class you should keep setting this field to `underReview`.|
|» securityAnimation|body|[SecurityAnimation](#schemasecurityanimation)|false|Optional information about the security animation. If this is set a security animation will be rendered on pass details.|
|» textModulesData|body|[[TextModuleData](#schematextmoduledata)]|false|Text module data. If text module data is also defined on the class, both will be displayed. The maximum number of these fields displayed is 10 from the object and 10 from the class.|
|» version|body|string(int64)|false|Deprecated|
|» viewUnlockRequirement|body|string|false|View Unlock Requirement options for the boarding pass.|
|» wordMark|body|[Image](#schemaimage)|false|Deprecated.|

|prettyPrint|query|boolean|false|Returns response with indentations and line breaks.|

<h1 id="google-pay-passes-api-flightobject">flightobject</h1>

## walletobjects.flightobject.list

<a id="opIdwalletobjects.flightobject.list"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/walletobjects/v1/flightObject \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /walletobjects/v1/flightObject`

Returns a list of all flight objects for a given issuer ID.

<h3 id="walletobjectsflightobjectlist-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|classId|query|string|false|The ID of the class whose objects will be listed.|
|maxResults|query|integer|false|Identifies the max number of results returned by a list. All results are returned if `maxResults` isn't defined.|
|token|query|string|false|Used to get the next set of results if `maxResults` is specified, but more than `maxResults` objects are available in a list. For example, if you have a list of 200 objects and you call list with `maxResults` set to 20, list will return the first 20 objects and a token. Call list again with `maxResults` set to 20 and the token to get the next 20 objects.|
|$.xgafv|query|string|false|V1 error format.|
|access_token|query|string|false|OAuth access token.|
|alt|query|string|false|Data format for response.|
|callback|query|string|false|JSONP|
|fields|query|string|false|Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response.|
|key|query|string|false|API key. Your API key identifies your project and provides you with API access, quota, and reports. Required unless you provide an OAuth 2.0 token.|
|oauth_token|query|string|false|OAuth 2.0 token for the current user.|
|prettyPrint|query|boolean|false|Returns response with indentations and line breaks.|
|quotaUser|query|string|false|Available to use for quota purposes for server-side applications. Can be any arbitrary string assigned to a user, but should not exceed 40 characters.|
|upload_protocol|query|string|false|Upload protocol for media (e.g. "raw", "multipart").|
|uploadType|query|string|false|Legacy upload protocol for media (e.g. "media", "multipart").|

<h3 id="walletobjectsflightobjectinsert-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|$.xgafv|query|string|false|V1 error format.|
|access_token|query|string|false|OAuth access token.|
|alt|query|string|false|Data format for response.|
|callback|query|string|false|JSONP|
|fields|query|string|false|Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response.|
|key|query|string|false|API key. Your API key identifies your project and provides you with API access, quota, and reports. Required unless you provide an OAuth 2.0 token.|
|oauth_token|query|string|false|OAuth 2.0 token for the current user.|
|prettyPrint|query|boolean|false|Returns response with indentations and line breaks.|
|quotaUser|query|string|false|Available to use for quota purposes for server-side applications. Can be any arbitrary string assigned to a user, but should not exceed 40 characters.|
|upload_protocol|query|string|false|Upload protocol for media (e.g. "raw", "multipart").|
|uploadType|query|string|false|Legacy upload protocol for media (e.g. "media", "multipart").|
|body|body|[FlightObject](#schemaflightobject)|false|none|
|» appLinkData|body|[AppLinkData](#schemaapplinkdata)|false|Optional information about the partner app link.|
|» barcode|body|[Barcode](#schemabarcode)|false|The barcode type and value.|
|» boardingAndSeatingInfo|body|[BoardingAndSeatingInfo](#schemaboardingandseatinginfo)|false|Passenger specific information about boarding and seating.|
|» classId|body|string|false|Required. The class associated with this object. The class must be of the same type as this object, must already exist, and must be approved. Class IDs should follow the format issuer ID.identifier where the former is issued by Google and latter is chosen by you.|
|» classReference|body|[FlightClass](#schemaflightclass)|false|A copy of the inherited fields of the parent class. These fields are retrieved during a GET.|
|» disableExpirationNotification|body|boolean|false|Indicates if notifications should explicitly be suppressed. If this field is set to true, regardless of the `messages` field, expiration notifications to the user will be suppressed. By default, this field is set to false. Currently, this can only be set for Flights.|
|» groupingInfo|body|[GroupingInfo](#schemagroupinginfo)|false|Information that controls how passes are grouped together.|
|» hasLinkedDevice|body|boolean|false|Whether this object is currently linked to a single device. This field is set by the platform when a user saves the object, linking it to their device. Intended for use by select partners. Contact support for additional information.|
|» hasUsers|body|boolean|false|Indicates if the object has users. This field is set by the platform.|
|» heroImage|body|[Image](#schemaimage)|false|Optional banner image displayed on the front of the card. If none is present, hero image of the class, if present, will be displayed. If hero image of the class is also not present, nothing will be displayed.|
|» hexBackgroundColor|body|string|false|The background color for the card. If not set the dominant color of the hero image is used, and if no hero image is set, the dominant color of the logo is used. The format is #rrggbb where rrggbb is a hex RGB triplet, such as `#ffcc00`. You can also use the shorthand version of the RGB triplet which is #rgb, such as `#fc0`.|
|» id|body|string|false|Required. The unique identifier for an object. This ID must be unique across all objects from an issuer. This value should follow the format issuer ID.identifier where the former is issued by Google and latter is chosen by you. The unique identifier should only include alphanumeric characters, '.', '_', or '-'.|
|» imageModulesData|body|[[ImageModuleData](#schemaimagemoduledata)]|false|Image module data. The maximum number of these fields displayed is 1 from object level and 1 for class object level.|
|» infoModuleData|body|[InfoModuleData](#schemainfomoduledata)|false|Deprecated. Use textModulesData instead.|
|» kind|body|string|false|Identifies what kind of resource this is. Value: the fixed string `"walletobjects#flightObject"`.|
|» linksModuleData|body|[LinksModuleData](#schemalinksmoduledata)|false|Links module data. If links module data is also defined on the class, both will be displayed.|
|» locations|body|[[LatLongPoint](#schemalatlongpoint)]|false|Note: This field is currently not supported to trigger geo notifications.|
|» messages|body|[[Message](#schemamessage)]|false|An array of messages displayed in the app. All users of this object will receive its associated messages. The maximum number of these fields is 10.|
|» passConstraints|body|[PassConstraints](#schemapassconstraints)|false|Pass constraints for the object.|
|» passengerName|body|string|false|Required. Passenger name as it would appear on the boarding pass. eg: "Dave M Gahan" or "Gahan/Dave" or "GAHAN/DAVEM"|
|» reservationInfo|body|[ReservationInfo](#schemareservationinfo)|false|Required. Information about flight reservation.|
|» rotatingBarcode|body|[RotatingBarcode](#schemarotatingbarcode)|false|The rotating barcode type and value.|
|» securityProgramLogo|body|[Image](#schemaimage)|false|An image for the security program that applies to the passenger.|
|» smartTapRedemptionValue|body|string|false|The value that will be transmitted to a Smart Tap certified terminal over NFC for this object. The class level fields `enableSmartTap` and `redemptionIssuers` must also be set up correctly in order for the pass to support Smart Tap. Only ASCII characters are supported.|
|» state|body|string|false|Required. The state of the object. This field is used to determine how an object is displayed in the app. For example, an `inactive` object is moved to the "Expired passes" section.|
|» textModulesData|body|[[TextModuleData](#schematextmoduledata)]|false|Text module data. If text module data is also defined on the class, both will be displayed. The maximum number of these fields displayed is 10 from the object and 10 from the class.|
|» validTimeInterval|body|[TimeInterval](#schematimeinterval)|false|The time period this object will be `active` and object can be used. An object's state will be changed to `expired` when this time period has passed.|
|» version|body|string(int64)|false|Deprecated|

## walletobjects.flightobject.get

<a id="opIdwalletobjects.flightobject.get"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/walletobjects/v1/flightObject/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /walletobjects/v1/flightObject/{resourceId}`

Returns the flight object with the given object ID.

<h3 id="walletobjectsflightobjectget-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|resourceId|path|string|true|The unique identifier for an object. This ID must be unique across all objects from an issuer. This value should follow the format issuer ID. identifier where the former is issued by Google and latter is chosen by you. Your unique identifier should only include alphanumeric characters, '.', '_', or '-'.|
|$.xgafv|query|string|false|V1 error format.|
|access_token|query|string|false|OAuth access token.|
|alt|query|string|false|Data format for response.|
|callback|query|string|false|JSONP|
|fields|query|string|false|Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response.|
|key|query|string|false|API key. Your API key identifies your project and provides you with API access, quota, and reports. Required unless you provide an OAuth 2.0 token.|
|oauth_token|query|string|false|OAuth 2.0 token for the current user.|
|prettyPrint|query|boolean|false|Returns response with indentations and line breaks.|
|quotaUser|query|string|false|Available to use for quota purposes for server-side applications. Can be any arbitrary string assigned to a user, but should not exceed 40 characters.|
|upload_protocol|query|string|false|Upload protocol for media (e.g. "raw", "multipart").|
|uploadType|query|string|false|Legacy upload protocol for media (e.g. "media", "multipart").|

|Parameter|Value|

|$.xgafv|2|

|alt|media|
|alt|proto|

<h3 id="walletobjectsflightobjectupdate-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|resourceId|path|string|true|The unique identifier for an object. This ID must be unique across all objects from an issuer. This value should follow the format issuer ID. identifier where the former is issued by Google and latter is chosen by you. Your unique identifier should only include alphanumeric characters, '.', '_', or '-'.|
|$.xgafv|query|string|false|V1 error format.|
|access_token|query|string|false|OAuth access token.|
|alt|query|string|false|Data format for response.|
|callback|query|string|false|JSONP|
|fields|query|string|false|Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response.|
|key|query|string|false|API key. Your API key identifies your project and provides you with API access, quota, and reports. Required unless you provide an OAuth 2.0 token.|
|oauth_token|query|string|false|OAuth 2.0 token for the current user.|
|prettyPrint|query|boolean|false|Returns response with indentations and line breaks.|
|quotaUser|query|string|false|Available to use for quota purposes for server-side applications. Can be any arbitrary string assigned to a user, but should not exceed 40 characters.|
|upload_protocol|query|string|false|Upload protocol for media (e.g. "raw", "multipart").|
|uploadType|query|string|false|Legacy upload protocol for media (e.g. "media", "multipart").|
|body|body|[FlightObject](#schemaflightobject)|false|none|
|» appLinkData|body|[AppLinkData](#schemaapplinkdata)|false|Optional information about the partner app link.|
|» barcode|body|[Barcode](#schemabarcode)|false|The barcode type and value.|
|» boardingAndSeatingInfo|body|[BoardingAndSeatingInfo](#schemaboardingandseatinginfo)|false|Passenger specific information about boarding and seating.|
|» classId|body|string|false|Required. The class associated with this object. The class must be of the same type as this object, must already exist, and must be approved. Class IDs should follow the format issuer ID.identifier where the former is issued by Google and latter is chosen by you.|
|» classReference|body|[FlightClass](#schemaflightclass)|false|A copy of the inherited fields of the parent class. These fields are retrieved during a GET.|
|» disableExpirationNotification|body|boolean|false|Indicates if notifications should explicitly be suppressed. If this field is set to true, regardless of the `messages` field, expiration notifications to the user will be suppressed. By default, this field is set to false. Currently, this can only be set for Flights.|
|» groupingInfo|body|[GroupingInfo](#schemagroupinginfo)|false|Information that controls how passes are grouped together.|
|» hasLinkedDevice|body|boolean|false|Whether this object is currently linked to a single device. This field is set by the platform when a user saves the object, linking it to their device. Intended for use by select partners. Contact support for additional information.|
|» hasUsers|body|boolean|false|Indicates if the object has users. This field is set by the platform.|
|» heroImage|body|[Image](#schemaimage)|false|Optional banner image displayed on the front of the card. If none is present, hero image of the class, if present, will be displayed. If hero image of the class is also not present, nothing will be displayed.|
|» hexBackgroundColor|body|string|false|The background color for the card. If not set the dominant color of the hero image is used, and if no hero image is set, the dominant color of the logo is used. The format is #rrggbb where rrggbb is a hex RGB triplet, such as `#ffcc00`. You can also use the shorthand version of the RGB triplet which is #rgb, such as `#fc0`.|
|» id|body|string|false|Required. The unique identifier for an object. This ID must be unique across all objects from an issuer. This value should follow the format issuer ID.identifier where the former is issued by Google and latter is chosen by you. The unique identifier should only include alphanumeric characters, '.', '_', or '-'.|
|» imageModulesData|body|[[ImageModuleData](#schemaimagemoduledata)]|false|Image module data. The maximum number of these fields displayed is 1 from object level and 1 for class object level.|
|» infoModuleData|body|[InfoModuleData](#schemainfomoduledata)|false|Deprecated. Use textModulesData instead.|
|» kind|body|string|false|Identifies what kind of resource this is. Value: the fixed string `"walletobjects#flightObject"`.|
|» linksModuleData|body|[LinksModuleData](#schemalinksmoduledata)|false|Links module data. If links module data is also defined on the class, both will be displayed.|
|» locations|body|[[LatLongPoint](#schemalatlongpoint)]|false|Note: This field is currently not supported to trigger geo notifications.|
|» messages|body|[[Message](#schemamessage)]|false|An array of messages displayed in the app. All users of this object will receive its associated messages. The maximum number of these fields is 10.|
|» passConstraints|body|[PassConstraints](#schemapassconstraints)|false|Pass constraints for the object.|
|» passengerName|body|string|false|Required. Passenger name as it would appear on the boarding pass. eg: "Dave M Gahan" or "Gahan/Dave" or "GAHAN/DAVEM"|
|» reservationInfo|body|[ReservationInfo](#schemareservationinfo)|false|Required. Information about flight reservation.|
|» rotatingBarcode|body|[RotatingBarcode](#schemarotatingbarcode)|false|The rotating barcode type and value.|
|» securityProgramLogo|body|[Image](#schemaimage)|false|An image for the security program that applies to the passenger.|
|» smartTapRedemptionValue|body|string|false|The value that will be transmitted to a Smart Tap certified terminal over NFC for this object. The class level fields `enableSmartTap` and `redemptionIssuers` must also be set up correctly in order for the pass to support Smart Tap. Only ASCII characters are supported.|
|» state|body|string|false|Required. The state of the object. This field is used to determine how an object is displayed in the app. For example, an `inactive` object is moved to the "Expired passes" section.|
|» textModulesData|body|[[TextModuleData](#schematextmoduledata)]|false|Text module data. If text module data is also defined on the class, both will be displayed. The maximum number of these fields displayed is 10 from the object and 10 from the class.|
|» validTimeInterval|body|[TimeInterval](#schematimeinterval)|false|The time period this object will be `active` and object can be used. An object's state will be changed to `expired` when this time period has passed.|
|» version|body|string(int64)|false|Deprecated|

<h3 id="walletobjectsflightobjectpatch-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|resourceId|path|string|true|The unique identifier for an object. This ID must be unique across all objects from an issuer. This value should follow the format issuer ID. identifier where the former is issued by Google and latter is chosen by you. Your unique identifier should only include alphanumeric characters, '.', '_', or '-'.|
|$.xgafv|query|string|false|V1 error format.|
|access_token|query|string|false|OAuth access token.|
|alt|query|string|false|Data format for response.|
|callback|query|string|false|JSONP|
|fields|query|string|false|Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response.|
|key|query|string|false|API key. Your API key identifies your project and provides you with API access, quota, and reports. Required unless you provide an OAuth 2.0 token.|
|oauth_token|query|string|false|OAuth 2.0 token for the current user.|
|prettyPrint|query|boolean|false|Returns response with indentations and line breaks.|
|quotaUser|query|string|false|Available to use for quota purposes for server-side applications. Can be any arbitrary string assigned to a user, but should not exceed 40 characters.|
|upload_protocol|query|string|false|Upload protocol for media (e.g. "raw", "multipart").|
|uploadType|query|string|false|Legacy upload protocol for media (e.g. "media", "multipart").|
|body|body|[FlightObject](#schemaflightobject)|false|none|
|» appLinkData|body|[AppLinkData](#schemaapplinkdata)|false|Optional information about the partner app link.|
|» barcode|body|[Barcode](#schemabarcode)|false|The barcode type and value.|
|» boardingAndSeatingInfo|body|[BoardingAndSeatingInfo](#schemaboardingandseatinginfo)|false|Passenger specific information about boarding and seating.|
|» classId|body|string|false|Required. The class associated with this object. The class must be of the same type as this object, must already exist, and must be approved. Class IDs should follow the format issuer ID.identifier where the former is issued by Google and latter is chosen by you.|
|» classReference|body|[FlightClass](#schemaflightclass)|false|A copy of the inherited fields of the parent class. These fields are retrieved during a GET.|
|» disableExpirationNotification|body|boolean|false|Indicates if notifications should explicitly be suppressed. If this field is set to true, regardless of the `messages` field, expiration notifications to the user will be suppressed. By default, this field is set to false. Currently, this can only be set for Flights.|
|» groupingInfo|body|[GroupingInfo](#schemagroupinginfo)|false|Information that controls how passes are grouped together.|
|» hasLinkedDevice|body|boolean|false|Whether this object is currently linked to a single device. This field is set by the platform when a user saves the object, linking it to their device. Intended for use by select partners. Contact support for additional information.|
|» hasUsers|body|boolean|false|Indicates if the object has users. This field is set by the platform.|
|» heroImage|body|[Image](#schemaimage)|false|Optional banner image displayed on the front of the card. If none is present, hero image of the class, if present, will be displayed. If hero image of the class is also not present, nothing will be displayed.|
|» hexBackgroundColor|body|string|false|The background color for the card. If not set the dominant color of the hero image is used, and if no hero image is set, the dominant color of the logo is used. The format is #rrggbb where rrggbb is a hex RGB triplet, such as `#ffcc00`. You can also use the shorthand version of the RGB triplet which is #rgb, such as `#fc0`.|
|» id|body|string|false|Required. The unique identifier for an object. This ID must be unique across all objects from an issuer. This value should follow the format issuer ID.identifier where the former is issued by Google and latter is chosen by you. The unique identifier should only include alphanumeric characters, '.', '_', or '-'.|
|» imageModulesData|body|[[ImageModuleData](#schemaimagemoduledata)]|false|Image module data. The maximum number of these fields displayed is 1 from object level and 1 for class object level.|
|» infoModuleData|body|[InfoModuleData](#schemainfomoduledata)|false|Deprecated. Use textModulesData instead.|
|» kind|body|string|false|Identifies what kind of resource this is. Value: the fixed string `"walletobjects#flightObject"`.|
|» linksModuleData|body|[LinksModuleData](#schemalinksmoduledata)|false|Links module data. If links module data is also defined on the class, both will be displayed.|
|» locations|body|[[LatLongPoint](#schemalatlongpoint)]|false|Note: This field is currently not supported to trigger geo notifications.|
|» messages|body|[[Message](#schemamessage)]|false|An array of messages displayed in the app. All users of this object will receive its associated messages. The maximum number of these fields is 10.|
|» passConstraints|body|[PassConstraints](#schemapassconstraints)|false|Pass constraints for the object.|
|» passengerName|body|string|false|Required. Passenger name as it would appear on the boarding pass. eg: "Dave M Gahan" or "Gahan/Dave" or "GAHAN/DAVEM"|
|» reservationInfo|body|[ReservationInfo](#schemareservationinfo)|false|Required. Information about flight reservation.|
|» rotatingBarcode|body|[RotatingBarcode](#schemarotatingbarcode)|false|The rotating barcode type and value.|
|» securityProgramLogo|body|[Image](#schemaimage)|false|An image for the security program that applies to the passenger.|
|» smartTapRedemptionValue|body|string|false|The value that will be transmitted to a Smart Tap certified terminal over NFC for this object. The class level fields `enableSmartTap` and `redemptionIssuers` must also be set up correctly in order for the pass to support Smart Tap. Only ASCII characters are supported.|
|» state|body|string|false|Required. The state of the object. This field is used to determine how an object is displayed in the app. For example, an `inactive` object is moved to the "Expired passes" section.|
|» textModulesData|body|[[TextModuleData](#schematextmoduledata)]|false|Text module data. If text module data is also defined on the class, both will be displayed. The maximum number of these fields displayed is 10 from the object and 10 from the class.|
|» validTimeInterval|body|[TimeInterval](#schematimeinterval)|false|The time period this object will be `active` and object can be used. An object's state will be changed to `expired` when this time period has passed.|
|» version|body|string(int64)|false|Deprecated|

<h1 id="google-pay-passes-api-genericclass">genericclass</h1>

## walletobjects.genericclass.list

<a id="opIdwalletobjects.genericclass.list"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/walletobjects/v1/genericClass \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /walletobjects/v1/genericClass`

Returns a list of all generic classes for a given issuer ID.

<h3 id="walletobjectsgenericclasslist-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|issuerId|query|string|false|The ID of the issuer authorized to list classes.|
|maxResults|query|integer|false|Identifies the max number of results returned by a list. All results are returned if `maxResults` isn't defined.|
|token|query|string|false|Used to get the next set of results if `maxResults` is specified, but more than `maxResults` classes are available in a list. For example, if you have a list of 200 classes and you call list with `maxResults` set to 20, list will return the first 20 classes and a token. Call list again with `maxResults` set to 20 and the token to get the next 20 classes.|
|$.xgafv|query|string|false|V1 error format.|
|access_token|query|string|false|OAuth access token.|
|alt|query|string|false|Data format for response.|
|callback|query|string|false|JSONP|
|fields|query|string|false|Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response.|
|key|query|string|false|API key. Your API key identifies your project and provides you with API access, quota, and reports. Required unless you provide an OAuth 2.0 token.|
|oauth_token|query|string|false|OAuth 2.0 token for the current user.|
|prettyPrint|query|boolean|false|Returns response with indentations and line breaks.|
|quotaUser|query|string|false|Available to use for quota purposes for server-side applications. Can be any arbitrary string assigned to a user, but should not exceed 40 characters.|
|upload_protocol|query|string|false|Upload protocol for media (e.g. "raw", "multipart").|
|uploadType|query|string|false|Legacy upload protocol for media (e.g. "media", "multipart").|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|$.xgafv|1|
|$.xgafv|2|
|alt|json|
|alt|media|
|alt|proto|

<h3 id="walletobjectsgenericclassinsert-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|$.xgafv|query|string|false|V1 error format.|
|access_token|query|string|false|OAuth access token.|
|alt|query|string|false|Data format for response.|
|callback|query|string|false|JSONP|
|fields|query|string|false|Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response.|
|key|query|string|false|API key. Your API key identifies your project and provides you with API access, quota, and reports. Required unless you provide an OAuth 2.0 token.|
|oauth_token|query|string|false|OAuth 2.0 token for the current user.|
|prettyPrint|query|boolean|false|Returns response with indentations and line breaks.|
|quotaUser|query|string|false|Available to use for quota purposes for server-side applications. Can be any arbitrary string assigned to a user, but should not exceed 40 characters.|
|upload_protocol|query|string|false|Upload protocol for media (e.g. "raw", "multipart").|
|uploadType|query|string|false|Legacy upload protocol for media (e.g. "media", "multipart").|
|body|body|[GenericClass](#schemagenericclass)|false|none|
|» callbackOptions|body|[CallbackOptions](#schemacallbackoptions)|false|Callback options to be used to call the issuer back for every save/delete of an object for this class by the end-user. All objects of this class are eligible for the callback.|
|» classTemplateInfo|body|[ClassTemplateInfo](#schemaclasstemplateinfo)|false|Template information about how the class should be displayed. If unset, Google will fallback to a default set of fields to display.|
|» enableSmartTap|body|boolean|false|Available only to Smart Tap enabled partners. Contact support for additional guidance.|
|» id|body|string|false|Required. The unique identifier for the class. This ID must be unique across all from an issuer. This value needs to follow the format `issuerID.identifier` where `issuerID` is issued by Google and `identifier` is chosen by you. The unique identifier can only include alphanumeric characters, `.`, `_`, or `-`.|
|» imageModulesData|body|[[ImageModuleData](#schemaimagemoduledata)]|false|Image module data. If `imageModulesData` is also defined on the object, both will be displayed. Only one of the image from class and one from object level will be rendered when both set.|
|» linksModuleData|body|[LinksModuleData](#schemalinksmoduledata)|false|Links module data. If `linksModuleData` is also defined on the object, both will be displayed. The maximum number of these fields displayed is 10 from class and 10 from object.|
|» multipleDevicesAndHoldersAllowedStatus|body|string|false|Identifies whether multiple users and devices will save the same object referencing this class.|
|» redemptionIssuers|body|[string(int64)]|false|Identifies which redemption issuers can redeem the pass over Smart Tap. Redemption issuers are identified by their issuer ID. Redemption issuers must have at least one Smart Tap key configured. The `enableSmartTap` and object level `smartTapRedemptionLevel` fields must also be set up correctly in order for a pass to support Smart Tap.|
|» securityAnimation|body|[SecurityAnimation](#schemasecurityanimation)|false|Optional information about the security animation. If this is set a security animation will be rendered on pass details.|
|» textModulesData|body|[[TextModuleData](#schematextmoduledata)]|false|Text module data. If `textModulesData` is also defined on the object, both will be displayed. The maximum number of these fields displayed is 10 from class and 10 from object.|
|» viewUnlockRequirement|body|string|false|View Unlock Requirement options for the generic pass.|

`GET /walletobjects/v1/genericClass/{resourceId}`

<h3 id="walletobjectsgenericclassget-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|resourceId|path|string|true|The unique identifier for a class. This ID must be unique across all classes from an issuer. This value needs to follow the format `issuerID.identifier` where `issuerID` is issued by Google and `identifier` is chosen by you. The unique identifier can only include alphanumeric characters, `.`, `_`, or `-`.|
|$.xgafv|query|string|false|V1 error format.|
|access_token|query|string|false|OAuth access token.|
|alt|query|string|false|Data format for response.|
|callback|query|string|false|JSONP|
|fields|query|string|false|Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response.|
|key|query|string|false|API key. Your API key identifies your project and provides you with API access, quota, and reports. Required unless you provide an OAuth 2.0 token.|
|oauth_token|query|string|false|OAuth 2.0 token for the current user.|
|prettyPrint|query|boolean|false|Returns response with indentations and line breaks.|
|quotaUser|query|string|false|Available to use for quota purposes for server-side applications. Can be any arbitrary string assigned to a user, but should not exceed 40 characters.|
|upload_protocol|query|string|false|Upload protocol for media (e.g. "raw", "multipart").|
|uploadType|query|string|false|Legacy upload protocol for media (e.g. "media", "multipart").|

<h3 id="walletobjectsgenericclassupdate-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|resourceId|path|string|true|The unique identifier for a class. This ID must be unique across all classes from an issuer. This value needs to follow the format `issuerID.identifier` where `issuerID` is issued by Google and `identifier` is chosen by you. The unique identifier can only include alphanumeric characters, `.`, `_`, or `-`.|
|$.xgafv|query|string|false|V1 error format.|
|access_token|query|string|false|OAuth access token.|
|alt|query|string|false|Data format for response.|
|callback|query|string|false|JSONP|
|fields|query|string|false|Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response.|
|key|query|string|false|API key. Your API key identifies your project and provides you with API access, quota, and reports. Required unless you provide an OAuth 2.0 token.|
|oauth_token|query|string|false|OAuth 2.0 token for the current user.|
|prettyPrint|query|boolean|false|Returns response with indentations and line breaks.|
|quotaUser|query|string|false|Available to use for quota purposes for server-side applications. Can be any arbitrary string assigned to a user, but should not exceed 40 characters.|
|upload_protocol|query|string|false|Upload protocol for media (e.g. "raw", "multipart").|
|uploadType|query|string|false|Legacy upload protocol for media (e.g. "media", "multipart").|
|body|body|[GenericClass](#schemagenericclass)|false|none|
|» callbackOptions|body|[CallbackOptions](#schemacallbackoptions)|false|Callback options to be used to call the issuer back for every save/delete of an object for this class by the end-user. All objects of this class are eligible for the callback.|
|» classTemplateInfo|body|[ClassTemplateInfo](#schemaclasstemplateinfo)|false|Template information about how the class should be displayed. If unset, Google will fallback to a default set of fields to display.|
|» enableSmartTap|body|boolean|false|Available only to Smart Tap enabled partners. Contact support for additional guidance.|
|» id|body|string|false|Required. The unique identifier for the class. This ID must be unique across all from an issuer. This value needs to follow the format `issuerID.identifier` where `issuerID` is issued by Google and `identifier` is chosen by you. The unique identifier can only include alphanumeric characters, `.`, `_`, or `-`.|
|» imageModulesData|body|[[ImageModuleData](#schemaimagemoduledata)]|false|Image module data. If `imageModulesData` is also defined on the object, both will be displayed. Only one of the image from class and one from object level will be rendered when both set.|
|» linksModuleData|body|[LinksModuleData](#schemalinksmoduledata)|false|Links module data. If `linksModuleData` is also defined on the object, both will be displayed. The maximum number of these fields displayed is 10 from class and 10 from object.|
|» multipleDevicesAndHoldersAllowedStatus|body|string|false|Identifies whether multiple users and devices will save the same object referencing this class.|
|» redemptionIssuers|body|[string(int64)]|false|Identifies which redemption issuers can redeem the pass over Smart Tap. Redemption issuers are identified by their issuer ID. Redemption issuers must have at least one Smart Tap key configured. The `enableSmartTap` and object level `smartTapRedemptionLevel` fields must also be set up correctly in order for a pass to support Smart Tap.|
|» securityAnimation|body|[SecurityAnimation](#schemasecurityanimation)|false|Optional information about the security animation. If this is set a security animation will be rendered on pass details.|
|» textModulesData|body|[[TextModuleData](#schematextmoduledata)]|false|Text module data. If `textModulesData` is also defined on the object, both will be displayed. The maximum number of these fields displayed is 10 from class and 10 from object.|
|» viewUnlockRequirement|body|string|false|View Unlock Requirement options for the generic pass.|

<h3 id="walletobjectsgenericclasspatch-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|resourceId|path|string|true|The unique identifier for a class. This ID must be unique across all classes from an issuer. This value needs to follow the format `issuerID.identifier` where `issuerID` is issued by Google and `identifier` is chosen by you. The unique identifier can only include alphanumeric characters, `.`, `_`, or `-`.|
|$.xgafv|query|string|false|V1 error format.|
|access_token|query|string|false|OAuth access token.|
|alt|query|string|false|Data format for response.|
|callback|query|string|false|JSONP|
|fields|query|string|false|Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response.|
|key|query|string|false|API key. Your API key identifies your project and provides you with API access, quota, and reports. Required unless you provide an OAuth 2.0 token.|
|oauth_token|query|string|false|OAuth 2.0 token for the current user.|
|prettyPrint|query|boolean|false|Returns response with indentations and line breaks.|
|quotaUser|query|string|false|Available to use for quota purposes for server-side applications. Can be any arbitrary string assigned to a user, but should not exceed 40 characters.|
|upload_protocol|query|string|false|Upload protocol for media (e.g. "raw", "multipart").|
|uploadType|query|string|false|Legacy upload protocol for media (e.g. "media", "multipart").|
|body|body|[GenericClass](#schemagenericclass)|false|none|
|» callbackOptions|body|[CallbackOptions](#schemacallbackoptions)|false|Callback options to be used to call the issuer back for every save/delete of an object for this class by the end-user. All objects of this class are eligible for the callback.|
|» classTemplateInfo|body|[ClassTemplateInfo](#schemaclasstemplateinfo)|false|Template information about how the class should be displayed. If unset, Google will fallback to a default set of fields to display.|
|» enableSmartTap|body|boolean|false|Available only to Smart Tap enabled partners. Contact support for additional guidance.|
|» id|body|string|false|Required. The unique identifier for the class. This ID must be unique across all from an issuer. This value needs to follow the format `issuerID.identifier` where `issuerID` is issued by Google and `identifier` is chosen by you. The unique identifier can only include alphanumeric characters, `.`, `_`, or `-`.|
|» imageModulesData|body|[[ImageModuleData](#schemaimagemoduledata)]|false|Image module data. If `imageModulesData` is also defined on the object, both will be displayed. Only one of the image from class and one from object level will be rendered when both set.|
|» linksModuleData|body|[LinksModuleData](#schemalinksmoduledata)|false|Links module data. If `linksModuleData` is also defined on the object, both will be displayed. The maximum number of these fields displayed is 10 from class and 10 from object.|
|» multipleDevicesAndHoldersAllowedStatus|body|string|false|Identifies whether multiple users and devices will save the same object referencing this class.|
|» redemptionIssuers|body|[string(int64)]|false|Identifies which redemption issuers can redeem the pass over Smart Tap. Redemption issuers are identified by their issuer ID. Redemption issuers must have at least one Smart Tap key configured. The `enableSmartTap` and object level `smartTapRedemptionLevel` fields must also be set up correctly in order for a pass to support Smart Tap.|
|» securityAnimation|body|[SecurityAnimation](#schemasecurityanimation)|false|Optional information about the security animation. If this is set a security animation will be rendered on pass details.|
|» textModulesData|body|[[TextModuleData](#schematextmoduledata)]|false|Text module data. If `textModulesData` is also defined on the object, both will be displayed. The maximum number of these fields displayed is 10 from class and 10 from object.|
|» viewUnlockRequirement|body|string|false|View Unlock Requirement options for the generic pass.|

<h1 id="google-pay-passes-api-genericobject">genericobject</h1>

## walletobjects.genericobject.list

<a id="opIdwalletobjects.genericobject.list"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/walletobjects/v1/genericObject \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /walletobjects/v1/genericObject`

Returns a list of all generic objects for a given issuer ID.

<h3 id="walletobjectsgenericobjectlist-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|classId|query|string|false|The ID of the class whose objects will be listed.|
|maxResults|query|integer|false|Identifies the max number of results returned by a list. All results are returned if `maxResults` isn't defined.|
|token|query|string|false|Used to get the next set of results if `maxResults` is specified, but more than `maxResults` objects are available in a list. For example, if you have a list of 200 objects and you call list with `maxResults` set to 20, list will return the first 20 objects and a token. Call list again with `maxResults` set to 20 and the token to get the next 20 objects.|
|$.xgafv|query|string|false|V1 error format.|
|access_token|query|string|false|OAuth access token.|
|alt|query|string|false|Data format for response.|
|callback|query|string|false|JSONP|
|fields|query|string|false|Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response.|
|key|query|string|false|API key. Your API key identifies your project and provides you with API access, quota, and reports. Required unless you provide an OAuth 2.0 token.|
|oauth_token|query|string|false|OAuth 2.0 token for the current user.|
|prettyPrint|query|boolean|false|Returns response with indentations and line breaks.|

<h3 id="walletobjectsgenericobjectinsert-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|$.xgafv|query|string|false|V1 error format.|
|access_token|query|string|false|OAuth access token.|
|alt|query|string|false|Data format for response.|
|callback|query|string|false|JSONP|
|fields|query|string|false|Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response.|
|key|query|string|false|API key. Your API key identifies your project and provides you with API access, quota, and reports. Required unless you provide an OAuth 2.0 token.|
|oauth_token|query|string|false|OAuth 2.0 token for the current user.|
|prettyPrint|query|boolean|false|Returns response with indentations and line breaks.|
|quotaUser|query|string|false|Available to use for quota purposes for server-side applications. Can be any arbitrary string assigned to a user, but should not exceed 40 characters.|
|upload_protocol|query|string|false|Upload protocol for media (e.g. "raw", "multipart").|
|uploadType|query|string|false|Legacy upload protocol for media (e.g. "media", "multipart").|
|body|body|[GenericObject](#schemagenericobject)|false|none|
|» appLinkData|body|[AppLinkData](#schemaapplinkdata)|false|Information about the partner app link. The maximum number of these fields displayed is 10.|
|» barcode|body|[Barcode](#schemabarcode)|false|The barcode type and value. If pass does not have a barcode, we can allow the issuer to set Barcode.alternate_text and display just that.|
|» cardTitle|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|Required. The header of the pass. This is usually the Business name such as "XXX Gym", "AAA Insurance". This field is required and appears in the header row at the very top of the pass.|
|» classId|body|string|false|Required. The class associated with this object. The class must be of the same type as this object, must already exist, and must be approved. Class IDs should follow the format `issuerID.identifier` where `issuerID` is issued by Google and `identifier` is chosen by you.|
|» genericType|body|string|false|Specify which `GenericType` the card belongs to. Deprecated.|
|» groupingInfo|body|[GroupingInfo](#schemagroupinginfo)|false|Information that controls how passes are grouped together.|
|» hasUsers|body|boolean|false|Indicates if the object has users. This field is set by the platform.|
|» header|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|Required. The title of the pass, such as "50% off coupon" or "Library card" or "Voucher". This field is required and appears in the title row of the pass detail view.|
|» heroImage|body|[Image](#schemaimage)|false|Banner image displayed on the front of the card if present. The image will be displayed at 100% width.|
|» hexBackgroundColor|body|string|false|The background color for the card. If not set, the dominant color of the hero image is used, and if no hero image is set, the dominant color of the logo is used and if logo is not set, a color would be chosen by Google.|
|» id|body|string|false|Required. The unique identifier for an object. This ID must be unique across all objects from an issuer. This value needs to follow the format `issuerID.identifier` where `issuerID` is issued by Google and `identifier` is chosen by you. The unique identifier can only include alphanumeric characters, `.`, `_`, or `-`.|
|» imageModulesData|body|[[ImageModuleData](#schemaimagemoduledata)]|false|Image module data. Only one of the image from class and one from object level will be rendered when both set.|
|» linksModuleData|body|[LinksModuleData](#schemalinksmoduledata)|false|Links module data. If `linksModuleData` is also defined on the class, both will be displayed. The maximum number of these fields displayed is 10 from class and 10 from object.|
|» logo|body|[Image](#schemaimage)|false|The logo image of the pass. This image is displayed in the card detail view in upper left, and also on the list/thumbnail view. If the logo is not present, the first letter of `cardTitle` would be shown as logo.|
|» notifications|body|[Notifications](#schemanotifications)|false|The notification settings that are enabled for this object.|
|» passConstraints|body|[PassConstraints](#schemapassconstraints)|false|Pass constraints for the object.|
|» rotatingBarcode|body|[RotatingBarcode](#schemarotatingbarcode)|false|The rotating barcode settings/details.|
|» smartTapRedemptionValue|body|string|false|The value that will be transmitted to a Smart Tap certified terminal over NFC for this object. The class level fields `enableSmartTap` and `redemptionIssuers` must also be set up correctly in order for the pass to support Smart Tap. Only ASCII characters are supported.|
|» state|body|string|false|The state of the object. This field is used to determine how an object is displayed in the app. For example, an `inactive` object is moved to the "Expired passes" section. If this is not provided, the object would be considered `ACTIVE`.|
|» subheader|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|The title label of the pass, such as location where this pass can be used. Appears right above the title in the title row in the pass detail view.|
|» textModulesData|body|[[TextModuleData](#schematextmoduledata)]|false|Text module data. If `textModulesData` is also defined on the class, both will be displayed. The maximum number of these fields displayed is 10 from class and 10 from object.|
|» validTimeInterval|body|[TimeInterval](#schematimeinterval)|false|The time period this object will be considered valid or usable. When the time period is passed, the object will be considered expired, which will affect the rendering on user's devices.|

`GET /walletobjects/v1/genericObject/{resourceId}`

Returns the generic object with the given object ID.

<h3 id="walletobjectsgenericobjectget-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|resourceId|path|string|true|The unique identifier for an object. This ID must be unique across all objects from an issuer. This value needs to follow the format `issuerID.identifier` where `issuerID` is issued by Google and `identifier` is chosen by you. The unique identifier can only include alphanumeric characters, `.`, `_`, or `-`.|
|$.xgafv|query|string|false|V1 error format.|
|access_token|query|string|false|OAuth access token.|
|alt|query|string|false|Data format for response.|
|callback|query|string|false|JSONP|
|fields|query|string|false|Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response.|
|key|query|string|false|API key. Your API key identifies your project and provides you with API access, quota, and reports. Required unless you provide an OAuth 2.0 token.|
|oauth_token|query|string|false|OAuth 2.0 token for the current user.|
|prettyPrint|query|boolean|false|Returns response with indentations and line breaks.|
|quotaUser|query|string|false|Available to use for quota purposes for server-side applications. Can be any arbitrary string assigned to a user, but should not exceed 40 characters.|
|upload_protocol|query|string|false|Upload protocol for media (e.g. "raw", "multipart").|
|uploadType|query|string|false|Legacy upload protocol for media (e.g. "media", "multipart").|

<h3 id="walletobjectsgenericobjectupdate-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|resourceId|path|string|true|The unique identifier for an object. This ID must be unique across all objects from an issuer. This value needs to follow the format `issuerID.identifier` where `issuerID` is issued by Google and `identifier` is chosen by you. The unique identifier can only include alphanumeric characters, `.`, `_`, or `-`.|
|$.xgafv|query|string|false|V1 error format.|
|access_token|query|string|false|OAuth access token.|
|alt|query|string|false|Data format for response.|
|callback|query|string|false|JSONP|
|fields|query|string|false|Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response.|
|key|query|string|false|API key. Your API key identifies your project and provides you with API access, quota, and reports. Required unless you provide an OAuth 2.0 token.|
|oauth_token|query|string|false|OAuth 2.0 token for the current user.|
|prettyPrint|query|boolean|false|Returns response with indentations and line breaks.|
|quotaUser|query|string|false|Available to use for quota purposes for server-side applications. Can be any arbitrary string assigned to a user, but should not exceed 40 characters.|
|upload_protocol|query|string|false|Upload protocol for media (e.g. "raw", "multipart").|
|uploadType|query|string|false|Legacy upload protocol for media (e.g. "media", "multipart").|
|body|body|[GenericObject](#schemagenericobject)|false|none|
|» appLinkData|body|[AppLinkData](#schemaapplinkdata)|false|Information about the partner app link. The maximum number of these fields displayed is 10.|
|» barcode|body|[Barcode](#schemabarcode)|false|The barcode type and value. If pass does not have a barcode, we can allow the issuer to set Barcode.alternate_text and display just that.|
|» cardTitle|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|Required. The header of the pass. This is usually the Business name such as "XXX Gym", "AAA Insurance". This field is required and appears in the header row at the very top of the pass.|
|» classId|body|string|false|Required. The class associated with this object. The class must be of the same type as this object, must already exist, and must be approved. Class IDs should follow the format `issuerID.identifier` where `issuerID` is issued by Google and `identifier` is chosen by you.|
|» genericType|body|string|false|Specify which `GenericType` the card belongs to. Deprecated.|
|» groupingInfo|body|[GroupingInfo](#schemagroupinginfo)|false|Information that controls how passes are grouped together.|
|» hasUsers|body|boolean|false|Indicates if the object has users. This field is set by the platform.|
|» header|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|Required. The title of the pass, such as "50% off coupon" or "Library card" or "Voucher". This field is required and appears in the title row of the pass detail view.|
|» heroImage|body|[Image](#schemaimage)|false|Banner image displayed on the front of the card if present. The image will be displayed at 100% width.|
|» hexBackgroundColor|body|string|false|The background color for the card. If not set, the dominant color of the hero image is used, and if no hero image is set, the dominant color of the logo is used and if logo is not set, a color would be chosen by Google.|
|» id|body|string|false|Required. The unique identifier for an object. This ID must be unique across all objects from an issuer. This value needs to follow the format `issuerID.identifier` where `issuerID` is issued by Google and `identifier` is chosen by you. The unique identifier can only include alphanumeric characters, `.`, `_`, or `-`.|
|» imageModulesData|body|[[ImageModuleData](#schemaimagemoduledata)]|false|Image module data. Only one of the image from class and one from object level will be rendered when both set.|
|» linksModuleData|body|[LinksModuleData](#schemalinksmoduledata)|false|Links module data. If `linksModuleData` is also defined on the class, both will be displayed. The maximum number of these fields displayed is 10 from class and 10 from object.|
|» logo|body|[Image](#schemaimage)|false|The logo image of the pass. This image is displayed in the card detail view in upper left, and also on the list/thumbnail view. If the logo is not present, the first letter of `cardTitle` would be shown as logo.|
|» notifications|body|[Notifications](#schemanotifications)|false|The notification settings that are enabled for this object.|
|» passConstraints|body|[PassConstraints](#schemapassconstraints)|false|Pass constraints for the object.|
|» rotatingBarcode|body|[RotatingBarcode](#schemarotatingbarcode)|false|The rotating barcode settings/details.|
|» smartTapRedemptionValue|body|string|false|The value that will be transmitted to a Smart Tap certified terminal over NFC for this object. The class level fields `enableSmartTap` and `redemptionIssuers` must also be set up correctly in order for the pass to support Smart Tap. Only ASCII characters are supported.|
|» state|body|string|false|The state of the object. This field is used to determine how an object is displayed in the app. For example, an `inactive` object is moved to the "Expired passes" section. If this is not provided, the object would be considered `ACTIVE`.|
|» subheader|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|The title label of the pass, such as location where this pass can be used. Appears right above the title in the title row in the pass detail view.|
|» textModulesData|body|[[TextModuleData](#schematextmoduledata)]|false|Text module data. If `textModulesData` is also defined on the class, both will be displayed. The maximum number of these fields displayed is 10 from class and 10 from object.|
|» validTimeInterval|body|[TimeInterval](#schematimeinterval)|false|The time period this object will be considered valid or usable. When the time period is passed, the object will be considered expired, which will affect the rendering on user's devices.|
