<h3 id="walletobjectsofferobjectinsert-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|$.xgafv|query|string|false|V1 error format.|
|access_token|query|string|false|OAuth access token.|
|alt|query|string|false|Data format for response.|
|callback|query|string|false|JSONP|
|fields|query|string|false|Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response.|
|key|query|string|false|API key. Your API key identifies your project and provides you with API access, quota, and reports. Required unless you provide an OAuth 2.0 token.|
|oauth_token|query|string|false|OAuth 2.0 token for the current user.|
|prettyPrint|query|boolean|false|Returns response with indentations and line breaks.|
|quotaUser|query|string|false|Available to use for quota purposes for server-side applications. Can be any arbitrary string assigned to a user, but should not exceed 40 characters.|
|upload_protocol|query|string|false|Upload protocol for media (e.g. "raw", "multipart").|
|uploadType|query|string|false|Legacy upload protocol for media (e.g. "media", "multipart").|
|body|body|[OfferObject](#schemaofferobject)|false|none|
|» appLinkData|body|[AppLinkData](#schemaapplinkdata)|false|Optional information about the partner app link.|
|» barcode|body|[Barcode](#schemabarcode)|false|The barcode type and value.|
|» classId|body|string|false|Required. The class associated with this object. The class must be of the same type as this object, must already exist, and must be approved. Class IDs should follow the format issuer ID.identifier where the former is issued by Google and latter is chosen by you.|
|» classReference|body|[OfferClass](#schemaofferclass)|false|A copy of the inherited fields of the parent class. These fields are retrieved during a GET.|
|» disableExpirationNotification|body|boolean|false|Indicates if notifications should explicitly be suppressed. If this field is set to true, regardless of the `messages` field, expiration notifications to the user will be suppressed. By default, this field is set to false. Currently, this can only be set for offers.|
|» groupingInfo|body|[GroupingInfo](#schemagroupinginfo)|false|Information that controls how passes are grouped together.|
|» hasLinkedDevice|body|boolean|false|Whether this object is currently linked to a single device. This field is set by the platform when a user saves the object, linking it to their device. Intended for use by select partners. Contact support for additional information.|
|» hasUsers|body|boolean|false|Indicates if the object has users. This field is set by the platform.|
|» heroImage|body|[Image](#schemaimage)|false|Optional banner image displayed on the front of the card. If none is present, hero image of the class, if present, will be displayed. If hero image of the class is also not present, nothing will be displayed.|
|» id|body|string|false|Required. The unique identifier for an object. This ID must be unique across all objects from an issuer. This value should follow the format issuer ID.identifier where the former is issued by Google and latter is chosen by you. The unique identifier should only include alphanumeric characters, '.', '_', or '-'.|
|» imageModulesData|body|[[ImageModuleData](#schemaimagemoduledata)]|false|Image module data. The maximum number of these fields displayed is 1 from object level and 1 for class object level.|
|» infoModuleData|body|[InfoModuleData](#schemainfomoduledata)|false|Deprecated. Use textModulesData instead.|
|» kind|body|string|false|Identifies what kind of resource this is. Value: the fixed string `"walletobjects#offerObject"`.|
|» linksModuleData|body|[LinksModuleData](#schemalinksmoduledata)|false|Links module data. If links module data is also defined on the class, both will be displayed.|
|» locations|body|[[LatLongPoint](#schemalatlongpoint)]|false|Note: This field is currently not supported to trigger geo notifications.|
|» messages|body|[[Message](#schemamessage)]|false|An array of messages displayed in the app. All users of this object will receive its associated messages. The maximum number of these fields is 10.|
|» passConstraints|body|[PassConstraints](#schemapassconstraints)|false|Pass constraints for the object.|
|» rotatingBarcode|body|[RotatingBarcode](#schemarotatingbarcode)|false|The rotating barcode type and value.|
|» smartTapRedemptionValue|body|string|false|The value that will be transmitted to a Smart Tap certified terminal over NFC for this object. The class level fields `enableSmartTap` and `redemptionIssuers` must also be set up correctly in order for the pass to support Smart Tap. Only ASCII characters are supported.|
|» state|body|string|false|Required. The state of the object. This field is used to determine how an object is displayed in the app. For example, an `inactive` object is moved to the "Expired passes" section.|
|» textModulesData|body|[[TextModuleData](#schematextmoduledata)]|false|Text module data. If text module data is also defined on the class, both will be displayed. The maximum number of these fields displayed is 10 from the object and 10 from the class.|
|» validTimeInterval|body|[TimeInterval](#schematimeinterval)|false|The time period this object will be `active` and object can be used. An object's state will be changed to `expired` when this time period has passed.|
|» version|body|string(int64)|false|Deprecated|

## walletobjects.offerobject.get

<a id="opIdwalletobjects.offerobject.get"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/walletobjects/v1/offerObject/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /walletobjects/v1/offerObject/{resourceId}`

Returns the offer object with the given object ID.

<h3 id="walletobjectsofferobjectget-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|resourceId|path|string|true|The unique identifier for an object. This ID must be unique across all objects from an issuer. This value should follow the format issuer ID. identifier where the former is issued by Google and latter is chosen by you. Your unique identifier should only include alphanumeric characters, '.', '_', or '-'.|
|$.xgafv|query|string|false|V1 error format.|
|access_token|query|string|false|OAuth access token.|
|alt|query|string|false|Data format for response.|
|callback|query|string|false|JSONP|
|fields|query|string|false|Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response.|
|key|query|string|false|API key. Your API key identifies your project and provides you with API access, quota, and reports. Required unless you provide an OAuth 2.0 token.|
|oauth_token|query|string|false|OAuth 2.0 token for the current user.|
|prettyPrint|query|boolean|false|Returns response with indentations and line breaks.|
|quotaUser|query|string|false|Available to use for quota purposes for server-side applications. Can be any arbitrary string assigned to a user, but should not exceed 40 characters.|
|upload_protocol|query|string|false|Upload protocol for media (e.g. "raw", "multipart").|
|uploadType|query|string|false|Legacy upload protocol for media (e.g. "media", "multipart").|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|$.xgafv|1|
|$.xgafv|2|
|alt|json|
|alt|media|
|alt|proto|

<h3 id="walletobjectsofferobjectupdate-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|resourceId|path|string|true|The unique identifier for an object. This ID must be unique across all objects from an issuer. This value should follow the format issuer ID. identifier where the former is issued by Google and latter is chosen by you. Your unique identifier should only include alphanumeric characters, '.', '_', or '-'.|
|$.xgafv|query|string|false|V1 error format.|
|access_token|query|string|false|OAuth access token.|
|alt|query|string|false|Data format for response.|
|callback|query|string|false|JSONP|
|fields|query|string|false|Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response.|
|key|query|string|false|API key. Your API key identifies your project and provides you with API access, quota, and reports. Required unless you provide an OAuth 2.0 token.|
|oauth_token|query|string|false|OAuth 2.0 token for the current user.|
|prettyPrint|query|boolean|false|Returns response with indentations and line breaks.|
|quotaUser|query|string|false|Available to use for quota purposes for server-side applications. Can be any arbitrary string assigned to a user, but should not exceed 40 characters.|
|upload_protocol|query|string|false|Upload protocol for media (e.g. "raw", "multipart").|
|uploadType|query|string|false|Legacy upload protocol for media (e.g. "media", "multipart").|
|body|body|[OfferObject](#schemaofferobject)|false|none|
|» appLinkData|body|[AppLinkData](#schemaapplinkdata)|false|Optional information about the partner app link.|
|» barcode|body|[Barcode](#schemabarcode)|false|The barcode type and value.|
|» classId|body|string|false|Required. The class associated with this object. The class must be of the same type as this object, must already exist, and must be approved. Class IDs should follow the format issuer ID.identifier where the former is issued by Google and latter is chosen by you.|
|» classReference|body|[OfferClass](#schemaofferclass)|false|A copy of the inherited fields of the parent class. These fields are retrieved during a GET.|
|» disableExpirationNotification|body|boolean|false|Indicates if notifications should explicitly be suppressed. If this field is set to true, regardless of the `messages` field, expiration notifications to the user will be suppressed. By default, this field is set to false. Currently, this can only be set for offers.|
|» groupingInfo|body|[GroupingInfo](#schemagroupinginfo)|false|Information that controls how passes are grouped together.|
|» hasLinkedDevice|body|boolean|false|Whether this object is currently linked to a single device. This field is set by the platform when a user saves the object, linking it to their device. Intended for use by select partners. Contact support for additional information.|
|» hasUsers|body|boolean|false|Indicates if the object has users. This field is set by the platform.|
|» heroImage|body|[Image](#schemaimage)|false|Optional banner image displayed on the front of the card. If none is present, hero image of the class, if present, will be displayed. If hero image of the class is also not present, nothing will be displayed.|
|» id|body|string|false|Required. The unique identifier for an object. This ID must be unique across all objects from an issuer. This value should follow the format issuer ID.identifier where the former is issued by Google and latter is chosen by you. The unique identifier should only include alphanumeric characters, '.', '_', or '-'.|
|» imageModulesData|body|[[ImageModuleData](#schemaimagemoduledata)]|false|Image module data. The maximum number of these fields displayed is 1 from object level and 1 for class object level.|
|» infoModuleData|body|[InfoModuleData](#schemainfomoduledata)|false|Deprecated. Use textModulesData instead.|
|» kind|body|string|false|Identifies what kind of resource this is. Value: the fixed string `"walletobjects#offerObject"`.|
|» linksModuleData|body|[LinksModuleData](#schemalinksmoduledata)|false|Links module data. If links module data is also defined on the class, both will be displayed.|
|» locations|body|[[LatLongPoint](#schemalatlongpoint)]|false|Note: This field is currently not supported to trigger geo notifications.|
|» messages|body|[[Message](#schemamessage)]|false|An array of messages displayed in the app. All users of this object will receive its associated messages. The maximum number of these fields is 10.|
|» passConstraints|body|[PassConstraints](#schemapassconstraints)|false|Pass constraints for the object.|
|» rotatingBarcode|body|[RotatingBarcode](#schemarotatingbarcode)|false|The rotating barcode type and value.|
|» smartTapRedemptionValue|body|string|false|The value that will be transmitted to a Smart Tap certified terminal over NFC for this object. The class level fields `enableSmartTap` and `redemptionIssuers` must also be set up correctly in order for the pass to support Smart Tap. Only ASCII characters are supported.|
|» state|body|string|false|Required. The state of the object. This field is used to determine how an object is displayed in the app. For example, an `inactive` object is moved to the "Expired passes" section.|
|» textModulesData|body|[[TextModuleData](#schematextmoduledata)]|false|Text module data. If text module data is also defined on the class, both will be displayed. The maximum number of these fields displayed is 10 from the object and 10 from the class.|
|» validTimeInterval|body|[TimeInterval](#schematimeinterval)|false|The time period this object will be `active` and object can be used. An object's state will be changed to `expired` when this time period has passed.|
|» version|body|string(int64)|false|Deprecated|

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|resourceId|path|string|true|The unique identifier for an object. This ID must be unique across all objects from an issuer. This value should follow the format issuer ID. identifier where the former is issued by Google and latter is chosen by you. Your unique identifier should only include alphanumeric characters, '.', '_', or '-'.|
|$.xgafv|query|string|false|V1 error format.|
|access_token|query|string|false|OAuth access token.|
|alt|query|string|false|Data format for response.|
|callback|query|string|false|JSONP|
|fields|query|string|false|Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response.|
|key|query|string|false|API key. Your API key identifies your project and provides you with API access, quota, and reports. Required unless you provide an OAuth 2.0 token.|
|oauth_token|query|string|false|OAuth 2.0 token for the current user.|
|prettyPrint|query|boolean|false|Returns response with indentations and line breaks.|
|quotaUser|query|string|false|Available to use for quota purposes for server-side applications. Can be any arbitrary string assigned to a user, but should not exceed 40 characters.|
|upload_protocol|query|string|false|Upload protocol for media (e.g. "raw", "multipart").|
|uploadType|query|string|false|Legacy upload protocol for media (e.g. "media", "multipart").|
|body|body|[OfferObject](#schemaofferobject)|false|none|
|» appLinkData|body|[AppLinkData](#schemaapplinkdata)|false|Optional information about the partner app link.|
|» barcode|body|[Barcode](#schemabarcode)|false|The barcode type and value.|
|» classId|body|string|false|Required. The class associated with this object. The class must be of the same type as this object, must already exist, and must be approved. Class IDs should follow the format issuer ID.identifier where the former is issued by Google and latter is chosen by you.|
|» classReference|body|[OfferClass](#schemaofferclass)|false|A copy of the inherited fields of the parent class. These fields are retrieved during a GET.|
|» disableExpirationNotification|body|boolean|false|Indicates if notifications should explicitly be suppressed. If this field is set to true, regardless of the `messages` field, expiration notifications to the user will be suppressed. By default, this field is set to false. Currently, this can only be set for offers.|
|» groupingInfo|body|[GroupingInfo](#schemagroupinginfo)|false|Information that controls how passes are grouped together.|
|» hasLinkedDevice|body|boolean|false|Whether this object is currently linked to a single device. This field is set by the platform when a user saves the object, linking it to their device. Intended for use by select partners. Contact support for additional information.|
|» hasUsers|body|boolean|false|Indicates if the object has users. This field is set by the platform.|
|» heroImage|body|[Image](#schemaimage)|false|Optional banner image displayed on the front of the card. If none is present, hero image of the class, if present, will be displayed. If hero image of the class is also not present, nothing will be displayed.|
|» id|body|string|false|Required. The unique identifier for an object. This ID must be unique across all objects from an issuer. This value should follow the format issuer ID.identifier where the former is issued by Google and latter is chosen by you. The unique identifier should only include alphanumeric characters, '.', '_', or '-'.|
|» imageModulesData|body|[[ImageModuleData](#schemaimagemoduledata)]|false|Image module data. The maximum number of these fields displayed is 1 from object level and 1 for class object level.|
|» infoModuleData|body|[InfoModuleData](#schemainfomoduledata)|false|Deprecated. Use textModulesData instead.|
|» kind|body|string|false|Identifies what kind of resource this is. Value: the fixed string `"walletobjects#offerObject"`.|
|» linksModuleData|body|[LinksModuleData](#schemalinksmoduledata)|false|Links module data. If links module data is also defined on the class, both will be displayed.|
|» locations|body|[[LatLongPoint](#schemalatlongpoint)]|false|Note: This field is currently not supported to trigger geo notifications.|
|» messages|body|[[Message](#schemamessage)]|false|An array of messages displayed in the app. All users of this object will receive its associated messages. The maximum number of these fields is 10.|
|» passConstraints|body|[PassConstraints](#schemapassconstraints)|false|Pass constraints for the object.|
|» rotatingBarcode|body|[RotatingBarcode](#schemarotatingbarcode)|false|The rotating barcode type and value.|
|» smartTapRedemptionValue|body|string|false|The value that will be transmitted to a Smart Tap certified terminal over NFC for this object. The class level fields `enableSmartTap` and `redemptionIssuers` must also be set up correctly in order for the pass to support Smart Tap. Only ASCII characters are supported.|
|» state|body|string|false|Required. The state of the object. This field is used to determine how an object is displayed in the app. For example, an `inactive` object is moved to the "Expired passes" section.|
|» textModulesData|body|[[TextModuleData](#schematextmoduledata)]|false|Text module data. If text module data is also defined on the class, both will be displayed. The maximum number of these fields displayed is 10 from the object and 10 from the class.|
|» validTimeInterval|body|[TimeInterval](#schematimeinterval)|false|The time period this object will be `active` and object can be used. An object's state will be changed to `expired` when this time period has passed.|
|» version|body|string(int64)|false|Deprecated|

<h1 id="google-pay-passes-api-permissions">permissions</h1>

## walletobjects.permissions.get

<a id="opIdwalletobjects.permissions.get"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/walletobjects/v1/permissions/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /walletobjects/v1/permissions/{resourceId}`

Returns the permissions for the given issuer id.

<h3 id="walletobjectspermissionsget-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|resourceId|path|string|true|The unique identifier for an issuer. This ID must be unique across all issuers.|
|$.xgafv|query|string|false|V1 error format.|
|access_token|query|string|false|OAuth access token.|
|alt|query|string|false|Data format for response.|
|callback|query|string|false|JSONP|
|fields|query|string|false|Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response.|
|key|query|string|false|API key. Your API key identifies your project and provides you with API access, quota, and reports. Required unless you provide an OAuth 2.0 token.|
|oauth_token|query|string|false|OAuth 2.0 token for the current user.|
|prettyPrint|query|boolean|false|Returns response with indentations and line breaks.|
|quotaUser|query|string|false|Available to use for quota purposes for server-side applications. Can be any arbitrary string assigned to a user, but should not exceed 40 characters.|
|upload_protocol|query|string|false|Upload protocol for media (e.g. "raw", "multipart").|
|uploadType|query|string|false|Legacy upload protocol for media (e.g. "media", "multipart").|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|$.xgafv|1|
|$.xgafv|2|
|alt|json|
|alt|media|
|alt|proto|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "issuerId": "string",
  "permissions": [
    {
      "emailAddress": "string",
      "role": "ROLE_UNSPECIFIED"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="walletobjectspermissionsget-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Successful response|[Permissions](#schemapermissions)|

## walletobjects.permissions.update

<a id="opIdwalletobjects.permissions.update"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/walletobjects/v1/permissions/string \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "issuerId": "string",
    "permissions": [
      {
        "emailAddress": "string",
        "role": "ROLE_UNSPECIFIED"
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`PUT /walletobjects/v1/permissions/{resourceId}`

Updates the permissions for the given issuer.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "issuerId": "string",
  "permissions": [
    {
      "emailAddress": "string",
      "role": "ROLE_UNSPECIFIED"
    }
  ]
}
```

`GET /walletobjects/v1/transitClass`

Returns a list of all transit classes for a given issuer ID.

|maxResults|query|integer|false|Identifies the max number of results returned by a list. All results are returned if `maxResults` isn't defined.|
|token|query|string|false|Used to get the next set of results if `maxResults` is specified, but more than `maxResults` classes are available in a list. For example, if you have a list of 200 classes and you call list with `maxResults` set to 20, list will return the first 20 classes and a token. <h3 id="walletobjectstransitclassinsert-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|$.xgafv|query|string|false|V1 error format.|
|access_token|query|string|false|OAuth access token.|
|alt|query|string|false|Data format for response.|
|callback|query|string|false|JSONP|
|fields|query|string|false|Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response.|
|key|query|string|false|API key. Your API key identifies your project and provides you with API access, quota, and reports. Required unless you provide an OAuth 2.0 token.|
|oauth_token|query|string|false|OAuth 2.0 token for the current user.|
|prettyPrint|query|boolean|false|Returns response with indentations and line breaks.|
|quotaUser|query|string|false|Available to use for quota purposes for server-side applications. Can be any arbitrary string assigned to a user, but should not exceed 40 characters.|
|upload_protocol|query|string|false|Upload protocol for media (e.g. "raw", "multipart").|
|uploadType|query|string|false|Legacy upload protocol for media (e.g. "media", "multipart").|
|body|body|[TransitClass](#schematransitclass)|false|none|
|» activationOptions|body|[ActivationOptions](#schemaactivationoptions)|false|Activation options for an activatable ticket.|
|» allowMultipleUsersPerObject|body|boolean|false|Deprecated. Use `multipleDevicesAndHoldersAllowedStatus` instead.|
|» callbackOptions|body|[CallbackOptions](#schemacallbackoptions)|false|Callback options to be used to call the issuer back for every save/delete of an object for this class by the end-user. All objects of this class are eligible for the callback.|
|» classTemplateInfo|body|[ClassTemplateInfo](#schemaclasstemplateinfo)|false|Template information about how the class should be displayed. If unset, Google will fallback to a default set of fields to display.|
|» countryCode|body|string|false|Country code used to display the card's country (when the user is not in that country), as well as to display localized content when content is not available in the user's locale.|
|» customCarriageLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the carriage value (`transitObject.ticketLeg.carriage`).|
|» customCoachLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the coach value (`transitObject.ticketLeg.ticketSeat.coach`).|
|» customConcessionCategoryLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the transit concession category value (`transitObject.concessionCategory`).|

|» customFareNameLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the transit fare name value (`transitObject.ticketLeg.fareName`).|
|» customOtherRestrictionsLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the other restrictions value (`transitObject.ticketRestrictions.otherRestrictions`).|
|» customPlatformLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the boarding platform value (`transitObject.ticketLeg.platform`).|
|» customPurchaseFaceValueLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the purchase face value (`transitObject.purchaseDetails.ticketCost.faceValue`).|
|» customPurchasePriceLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the purchase price value (`transitObject.purchaseDetails.ticketCost.purchasePrice`).|
|» customPurchaseReceiptNumberLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the purchase receipt number value (`transitObject.purchaseDetails.purchaseReceiptNumber`).|
|» customRouteRestrictionsDetailsLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the route restrictions details value (`transitObject.ticketRestrictions.routeRestrictionsDetails`).|
|» customRouteRestrictionsLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the route restrictions value (`transitObject.ticketRestrictions.routeRestrictions`).|
|» customSeatLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the seat location value (`transitObject.ticketLeg.ticketSeat.seat`).|
|» customTicketNumberLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the ticket number value (`transitObject.ticketNumber`).|
|» customTimeRestrictionsLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the time restrictions details value (`transitObject.ticketRestrictions.timeRestrictions`).|
|» customTransitTerminusNameLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the transit terminus name value (`transitObject.ticketLeg.transitTerminusName`).|
|» customZoneLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the boarding zone value (`transitObject.ticketLeg.zone`).|
|» enableSingleLegItinerary|body|boolean|false|Controls the display of the single-leg itinerary for this class. By default, an itinerary will only display for multi-leg trips.|
|» enableSmartTap|body|boolean|false|Identifies whether this class supports Smart Tap. The `redemptionIssuers` and object level `smartTapRedemptionLevel` fields must also be set up correctly in order for a pass to support Smart Tap.|
|» heroImage|body|[Image](#schemaimage)|false|Optional banner image displayed on the front of the card. If none is present, nothing will be displayed. The image will display at 100% width.|
|» hexBackgroundColor|body|string|false|The background color for the card. If not set the dominant color of the hero image is used, and if no hero image is set, the dominant color of the logo is used. The format is #rrggbb where rrggbb is a hex RGB triplet, such as `#ffcc00`. You can also use the shorthand version of the RGB triplet which is #rgb, such as `#fc0`.|
|» homepageUri|body|[Uri](#schemauri)|false|The URI of your application's home page. Populating the URI in this field results in the exact same behavior as populating an URI in linksModuleData (when an object is rendered, a link to the homepage is shown in what would usually be thought of as the linksModuleData section of the object).|
|» id|body|string|false|Required. The unique identifier for a class. This ID must be unique across all classes from an issuer. This value should follow the format issuer ID. identifier where the former is issued by Google and latter is chosen by you. Your unique identifier should only include alphanumeric characters, '.', '_', or '-'.|
|» imageModulesData|body|[[ImageModuleData](#schemaimagemoduledata)]|false|Image module data. The maximum number of these fields displayed is 1 from object level and 1 for class object level.|
|» infoModuleData|body|[InfoModuleData](#schemainfomoduledata)|false|Deprecated. Use textModulesData instead.|
|» issuerName|body|string|false|Required. The issuer name. Recommended maximum length is 20 characters to ensure full string is displayed on smaller screens.|
|» languageOverride|body|string|false|If this field is present, transit tickets served to a user's device will always be in this language. Represents the BCP 47 language tag. Example values are "en-US", "en-GB", "de", or "de-AT".|
|» linksModuleData|body|[LinksModuleData](#schemalinksmoduledata)|false|Links module data. If links module data is also defined on the object, both will be displayed.|
|» localizedIssuerName|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|Translated strings for the issuer_name. Recommended maximum length is 20 characters to ensure full string is displayed on smaller screens.|
|» locations|body|[[LatLongPoint](#schemalatlongpoint)]|false|Note: This field is currently not supported to trigger geo notifications.|
|» logo|body|[Image](#schemaimage)|false|Required. The logo image of the ticket. This image is displayed in the card detail view of the app.|
|» messages|body|[[Message](#schemamessage)]|false|An array of messages displayed in the app. All users of this object will receive its associated messages. The maximum number of these fields is 10.|
|» multipleDevicesAndHoldersAllowedStatus|body|string|false|Identifies whether multiple users and devices will save the same object referencing this class.|
|» redemptionIssuers|body|[string(int64)]|false|Identifies which redemption issuers can redeem the pass over Smart Tap. Redemption issuers are identified by their issuer ID. Redemption issuers must have at least one Smart Tap key configured. The `enableSmartTap` and object level `smartTapRedemptionLevel` fields must also be set up correctly in order for a pass to support Smart Tap.|
|» review|body|[Review](#schemareview)|false|The review comments set by the platform when a class is marked `approved` or `rejected`.|
|» reviewStatus|body|string|false|Required. The status of the class. This field can be set to `draft` or `underReview` using the insert, patch, or update API calls. Once the review state is changed from `draft` it may not be changed back to `draft`. You should keep this field to `draft` when the class is under development. A `draft` class cannot be used to create any object. You should set this field to `underReview` when you believe the class is ready for use. The platform will automatically set this field to `approved` and it can be immediately used to create or migrate objects. When updating an already `approved` class you should keep setting this field to `underReview`.|
|» securityAnimation|body|[SecurityAnimation](#schemasecurityanimation)|false|Optional information about the security animation. If this is set a security animation will be rendered on pass details.|
|» textModulesData|body|[[TextModuleData](#schematextmoduledata)]|false|Text module data. If text module data is also defined on the class, both will be displayed. The maximum number of these fields displayed is 10 from the object and 10 from the class.|
|» transitOperatorName|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|The name of the transit operator.|
|» transitType|body|string|false|Required. The type of transit this class represents, such as "bus".|
|» version|body|string(int64)|false|Deprecated|
|» viewUnlockRequirement|body|string|false|View Unlock Requirement options for the transit ticket.|
|» watermark|body|[Image](#schemaimage)|false|Watermark image to display on the user's device.|
|» wordMark|body|[Image](#schemaimage)|false|Deprecated.|

## walletobjects.transitclass.get

<a id="opIdwalletobjects.transitclass.get"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/walletobjects/v1/transitClass/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /walletobjects/v1/transitClass/{resourceId}`

Returns the transit class with the given class ID.

<h3 id="walletobjectstransitclassget-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|resourceId|path|string|true|The unique identifier for a class. This ID must be unique across all classes from an issuer. This value should follow the format issuer ID. identifier where the former is issued by Google and latter is chosen by you. Your unique identifier should only include alphanumeric characters, '.', '_', or '-'.|
|$.xgafv|query|string|false|V1 error format.|
|access_token|query|string|false|OAuth access token.|
|alt|query|string|false|Data format for response.|
|callback|query|string|false|JSONP|
|fields|query|string|false|Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response.|
|key|query|string|false|API key. Your API key identifies your project and provides you with API access, quota, and reports. Required unless you provide an OAuth 2.0 token.|
|oauth_token|query|string|false|OAuth 2.0 token for the current user.|
|prettyPrint|query|boolean|false|Returns response with indentations and line breaks.|
|quotaUser|query|string|false|Available to use for quota purposes for server-side applications. Can be any arbitrary string assigned to a user, but should not exceed 40 characters.|
|upload_protocol|query|string|false|Upload protocol for media (e.g. "raw", "multipart").|
|uploadType|query|string|false|Legacy upload protocol for media (e.g. "media", "multipart").|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|$.xgafv|1|
|$.xgafv|2|
|alt|json|
|alt|media|
|alt|proto|

<h3 id="walletobjectstransitclassupdate-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|resourceId|path|string|true|The unique identifier for a class. This ID must be unique across all classes from an issuer. This value should follow the format issuer ID. identifier where the former is issued by Google and latter is chosen by you. Your unique identifier should only include alphanumeric characters, '.', '_', or '-'.|
|$.xgafv|query|string|false|V1 error format.|
|access_token|query|string|false|OAuth access token.|
|alt|query|string|false|Data format for response.|
|callback|query|string|false|JSONP|
|fields|query|string|false|Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response.|
|key|query|string|false|API key. Your API key identifies your project and provides you with API access, quota, and reports. Required unless you provide an OAuth 2.0 token.|
|oauth_token|query|string|false|OAuth 2.0 token for the current user.|
|prettyPrint|query|boolean|false|Returns response with indentations and line breaks.|
|quotaUser|query|string|false|Available to use for quota purposes for server-side applications. Can be any arbitrary string assigned to a user, but should not exceed 40 characters.|
|upload_protocol|query|string|false|Upload protocol for media (e.g. "raw", "multipart").|
|uploadType|query|string|false|Legacy upload protocol for media (e.g. "media", "multipart").|
|body|body|[TransitClass](#schematransitclass)|false|none|
|» activationOptions|body|[ActivationOptions](#schemaactivationoptions)|false|Activation options for an activatable ticket.|
|» allowMultipleUsersPerObject|body|boolean|false|Deprecated. Use `multipleDevicesAndHoldersAllowedStatus` instead.|
|» callbackOptions|body|[CallbackOptions](#schemacallbackoptions)|false|Callback options to be used to call the issuer back for every save/delete of an object for this class by the end-user. All objects of this class are eligible for the callback.|
|» classTemplateInfo|body|[ClassTemplateInfo](#schemaclasstemplateinfo)|false|Template information about how the class should be displayed. If unset, Google will fallback to a default set of fields to display.|
|» countryCode|body|string|false|Country code used to display the card's country (when the user is not in that country), as well as to display localized content when content is not available in the user's locale.|
|» customCarriageLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the carriage value (`transitObject.ticketLeg.carriage`).|
|» customCoachLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the coach value (`transitObject.ticketLeg.ticketSeat.coach`).|
|» customConcessionCategoryLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the transit concession category value (`transitObject.concessionCategory`).|
|» customConfirmationCodeLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the confirmation code value (`transitObject.purchaseDetails.confirmationCode`).|
|» customDiscountMessageLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the transit discount message value (`transitObject.purchaseDetails.ticketCost.discountMessage`).|
|» customFareClassLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the fare class value (`transitObject.ticketLeg.ticketSeat.fareClass`).|
|» customFareNameLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the transit fare name value (`transitObject.ticketLeg.fareName`).|
|» customOtherRestrictionsLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the other restrictions value (`transitObject.ticketRestrictions.otherRestrictions`).|
|» customPlatformLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the boarding platform value (`transitObject.ticketLeg.platform`).|
|» customPurchaseFaceValueLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the purchase face value (`transitObject.purchaseDetails.ticketCost.faceValue`).|
|» customPurchasePriceLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the purchase price value (`transitObject.purchaseDetails.ticketCost.purchasePrice`).|
|» customPurchaseReceiptNumberLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the purchase receipt number value (`transitObject.purchaseDetails.purchaseReceiptNumber`).|
|» customRouteRestrictionsDetailsLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the route restrictions details value (`transitObject.ticketRestrictions.routeRestrictionsDetails`).|
|» customRouteRestrictionsLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the route restrictions value (`transitObject.ticketRestrictions.routeRestrictions`).|
|» customSeatLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the seat location value (`transitObject.ticketLeg.ticketSeat.seat`).|
|» customTicketNumberLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the ticket number value (`transitObject.ticketNumber`).|
|» customTimeRestrictionsLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the time restrictions details value (`transitObject.ticketRestrictions.timeRestrictions`).|
|» customTransitTerminusNameLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the transit terminus name value (`transitObject.ticketLeg.transitTerminusName`).|
|» customZoneLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the boarding zone value (`transitObject.ticketLeg.zone`).|
|» enableSingleLegItinerary|body|boolean|false|Controls the display of the single-leg itinerary for this class. By default, an itinerary will only display for multi-leg trips.|
|» enableSmartTap|body|boolean|false|Identifies whether this class supports Smart Tap. The `redemptionIssuers` and object level `smartTapRedemptionLevel` fields must also be set up correctly in order for a pass to support Smart Tap.|
|» heroImage|body|[Image](#schemaimage)|false|Optional banner image displayed on the front of the card. If none is present, nothing will be displayed. The image will display at 100% width.|
|» hexBackgroundColor|body|string|false|The background color for the card. If not set the dominant color of the hero image is used, and if no hero image is set, the dominant color of the logo is used. The format is #rrggbb where rrggbb is a hex RGB triplet, such as `#ffcc00`. You can also use the shorthand version of the RGB triplet which is #rgb, such as `#fc0`.|
|» homepageUri|body|[Uri](#schemauri)|false|The URI of your application's home page. Populating the URI in this field results in the exact same behavior as populating an URI in linksModuleData (when an object is rendered, a link to the homepage is shown in what would usually be thought of as the linksModuleData section of the object).|
|» id|body|string|false|Required. The unique identifier for a class. This ID must be unique across all classes from an issuer. This value should follow the format issuer ID. identifier where the former is issued by Google and latter is chosen by you. Your unique identifier should only include alphanumeric characters, '.', '_', or '-'.|
|» imageModulesData|body|[[ImageModuleData](#schemaimagemoduledata)]|false|Image module data. The maximum number of these fields displayed is 1 from object level and 1 for class object level.|
|» infoModuleData|body|[InfoModuleData](#schemainfomoduledata)|false|Deprecated. Use textModulesData instead.|
|» issuerName|body|string|false|Required. The issuer name. Recommended maximum length is 20 characters to ensure full string is displayed on smaller screens.|
|» languageOverride|body|string|false|If this field is present, transit tickets served to a user's device will always be in this language. Represents the BCP 47 language tag. Example values are "en-US", "en-GB", "de", or "de-AT".|
|» linksModuleData|body|[LinksModuleData](#schemalinksmoduledata)|false|Links module data. If links module data is also defined on the object, both will be displayed.|
|» localizedIssuerName|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|Translated strings for the issuer_name. Recommended maximum length is 20 characters to ensure full string is displayed on smaller screens.|
|» locations|body|[[LatLongPoint](#schemalatlongpoint)]|false|Note: This field is currently not supported to trigger geo notifications.|
|» logo|body|[Image](#schemaimage)|false|Required. The logo image of the ticket. This image is displayed in the card detail view of the app.|
|» messages|body|[[Message](#schemamessage)]|false|An array of messages displayed in the app. All users of this object will receive its associated messages. The maximum number of these fields is 10.|
|» multipleDevicesAndHoldersAllowedStatus|body|string|false|Identifies whether multiple users and devices will save the same object referencing this class.|
|» redemptionIssuers|body|[string(int64)]|false|Identifies which redemption issuers can redeem the pass over Smart Tap. Redemption issuers are identified by their issuer ID. Redemption issuers must have at least one Smart Tap key configured. The `enableSmartTap` and object level `smartTapRedemptionLevel` fields must also be set up correctly in order for a pass to support Smart Tap.|
|» review|body|[Review](#schemareview)|false|The review comments set by the platform when a class is marked `approved` or `rejected`.|
|» reviewStatus|body|string|false|Required. The status of the class. This field can be set to `draft` or `underReview` using the insert, patch, or update API calls. Once the review state is changed from `draft` it may not be changed back to `draft`. You should keep this field to `draft` when the class is under development. A `draft` class cannot be used to create any object. You should set this field to `underReview` when you believe the class is ready for use. The platform will automatically set this field to `approved` and it can be immediately used to create or migrate objects. When updating an already `approved` class you should keep setting this field to `underReview`.|
|» securityAnimation|body|[SecurityAnimation](#schemasecurityanimation)|false|Optional information about the security animation. If this is set a security animation will be rendered on pass details.|
|» textModulesData|body|[[TextModuleData](#schematextmoduledata)]|false|Text module data. If text module data is also defined on the class, both will be displayed. The maximum number of these fields displayed is 10 from the object and 10 from the class.|
|» transitOperatorName|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|The name of the transit operator.|
|» transitType|body|string|false|Required. The type of transit this class represents, such as "bus".|
|» version|body|string(int64)|false|Deprecated|
|» viewUnlockRequirement|body|string|false|View Unlock Requirement options for the transit ticket.|
|» watermark|body|[Image](#schemaimage)|false|Watermark image to display on the user's device.|
|» wordMark|body|[Image](#schemaimage)|false|Deprecated.|

<h3 id="walletobjectstransitclasspatch-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|resourceId|path|string|true|The unique identifier for a class. This ID must be unique across all classes from an issuer. This value should follow the format issuer ID. identifier where the former is issued by Google and latter is chosen by you. Your unique identifier should only include alphanumeric characters, '.', '_', or '-'.|
|$.xgafv|query|string|false|V1 error format.|
|access_token|query|string|false|OAuth access token.|
|alt|query|string|false|Data format for response.|
|callback|query|string|false|JSONP|
|fields|query|string|false|Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response.|
|key|query|string|false|API key. Your API key identifies your project and provides you with API access, quota, and reports. Required unless you provide an OAuth 2.0 token.|
|oauth_token|query|string|false|OAuth 2.0 token for the current user.|
|prettyPrint|query|boolean|false|Returns response with indentations and line breaks.|
|quotaUser|query|string|false|Available to use for quota purposes for server-side applications. Can be any arbitrary string assigned to a user, but should not exceed 40 characters.|
|upload_protocol|query|string|false|Upload protocol for media (e.g. "raw", "multipart").|
|uploadType|query|string|false|Legacy upload protocol for media (e.g. "media", "multipart").|
|body|body|[TransitClass](#schematransitclass)|false|none|
|» activationOptions|body|[ActivationOptions](#schemaactivationoptions)|false|Activation options for an activatable ticket.|
|» allowMultipleUsersPerObject|body|boolean|false|Deprecated. Use `multipleDevicesAndHoldersAllowedStatus` instead.|
|» callbackOptions|body|[CallbackOptions](#schemacallbackoptions)|false|Callback options to be used to call the issuer back for every save/delete of an object for this class by the end-user. All objects of this class are eligible for the callback.|
|» classTemplateInfo|body|[ClassTemplateInfo](#schemaclasstemplateinfo)|false|Template information about how the class should be displayed. If unset, Google will fallback to a default set of fields to display.|
|» countryCode|body|string|false|Country code used to display the card's country (when the user is not in that country), as well as to display localized content when content is not available in the user's locale.|
|» customCarriageLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the carriage value (`transitObject.ticketLeg.carriage`).|
|» customCoachLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the coach value (`transitObject.ticketLeg.ticketSeat.coach`).|
|» customConcessionCategoryLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the transit concession category value (`transitObject.concessionCategory`).|
|» customConfirmationCodeLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the confirmation code value (`transitObject.purchaseDetails.confirmationCode`).|
|» customDiscountMessageLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the transit discount message value (`transitObject.purchaseDetails.ticketCost.discountMessage`).|
|» customFareClassLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the fare class value (`transitObject.ticketLeg.ticketSeat.fareClass`).|
|» customFareNameLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the transit fare name value (`transitObject.ticketLeg.fareName`).|
|» customOtherRestrictionsLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the other restrictions value (`transitObject.ticketRestrictions.otherRestrictions`).|
|» customPlatformLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the boarding platform value (`transitObject.ticketLeg.platform`).|
|» customPurchaseFaceValueLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the purchase face value (`transitObject.purchaseDetails.ticketCost.faceValue`).|
|» customPurchasePriceLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the purchase price value (`transitObject.purchaseDetails.ticketCost.purchasePrice`).|
|» customPurchaseReceiptNumberLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the purchase receipt number value (`transitObject.purchaseDetails.purchaseReceiptNumber`).|
|» customRouteRestrictionsDetailsLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the route restrictions details value (`transitObject.ticketRestrictions.routeRestrictionsDetails`).|
|» customRouteRestrictionsLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the route restrictions value (`transitObject.ticketRestrictions.routeRestrictions`).|
|» customSeatLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the seat location value (`transitObject.ticketLeg.ticketSeat.seat`).|
|» customTicketNumberLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the ticket number value (`transitObject.ticketNumber`).|
|» customTimeRestrictionsLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the time restrictions details value (`transitObject.ticketRestrictions.timeRestrictions`).|
|» customTransitTerminusNameLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the transit terminus name value (`transitObject.ticketLeg.transitTerminusName`).|
|» customZoneLabel|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom label to use for the boarding zone value (`transitObject.ticketLeg.zone`).|
|» enableSingleLegItinerary|body|boolean|false|Controls the display of the single-leg itinerary for this class. By default, an itinerary will only display for multi-leg trips.|
|» enableSmartTap|body|boolean|false|Identifies whether this class supports Smart Tap. The `redemptionIssuers` and object level `smartTapRedemptionLevel` fields must also be set up correctly in order for a pass to support Smart Tap.|
|» heroImage|body|[Image](#schemaimage)|false|Optional banner image displayed on the front of the card. If none is present, nothing will be displayed. The image will display at 100% width.|
|» hexBackgroundColor|body|string|false|The background color for the card. If not set the dominant color of the hero image is used, and if no hero image is set, the dominant color of the logo is used. The format is #rrggbb where rrggbb is a hex RGB triplet, such as `#ffcc00`. You can also use the shorthand version of the RGB triplet which is #rgb, such as `#fc0`.|
|» homepageUri|body|[Uri](#schemauri)|false|The URI of your application's home page. Populating the URI in this field results in the exact same behavior as populating an URI in linksModuleData (when an object is rendered, a link to the homepage is shown in what would usually be thought of as the linksModuleData section of the object).|
|» id|body|string|false|Required. The unique identifier for a class. This ID must be unique across all classes from an issuer. This value should follow the format issuer ID. identifier where the former is issued by Google and latter is chosen by you. Your unique identifier should only include alphanumeric characters, '.', '_', or '-'.|
|» imageModulesData|body|[[ImageModuleData](#schemaimagemoduledata)]|false|Image module data. The maximum number of these fields displayed is 1 from object level and 1 for class object level.|
|» infoModuleData|body|[InfoModuleData](#schemainfomoduledata)|false|Deprecated. Use textModulesData instead.|
|» issuerName|body|string|false|Required. The issuer name. Recommended maximum length is 20 characters to ensure full string is displayed on smaller screens.|
|» languageOverride|body|string|false|If this field is present, transit tickets served to a user's device will always be in this language. Represents the BCP 47 language tag. Example values are "en-US", "en-GB", "de", or "de-AT".|
|» linksModuleData|body|[LinksModuleData](#schemalinksmoduledata)|false|Links module data. If links module data is also defined on the object, both will be displayed.|
|» localizedIssuerName|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|Translated strings for the issuer_name. Recommended maximum length is 20 characters to ensure full string is displayed on smaller screens.|
|» locations|body|[[LatLongPoint](#schemalatlongpoint)]|false|Note: This field is currently not supported to trigger geo notifications.|
|» logo|body|[Image](#schemaimage)|false|Required. The logo image of the ticket. This image is displayed in the card detail view of the app.|
|» messages|body|[[Message](#schemamessage)]|false|An array of messages displayed in the app. All users of this object will receive its associated messages. The maximum number of these fields is 10.|
|» multipleDevicesAndHoldersAllowedStatus|body|string|false|Identifies whether multiple users and devices will save the same object referencing this class.|
|» redemptionIssuers|body|[string(int64)]|false|Identifies which redemption issuers can redeem the pass over Smart Tap. Redemption issuers are identified by their issuer ID. Redemption issuers must have at least one Smart Tap key configured. The `enableSmartTap` and object level `smartTapRedemptionLevel` fields must also be set up correctly in order for a pass to support Smart Tap.|
|» review|body|[Review](#schemareview)|false|The review comments set by the platform when a class is marked `approved` or `rejected`.|
|» reviewStatus|body|string|false|Required. The status of the class. This field can be set to `draft` or `underReview` using the insert, patch, or update API calls. Once the review state is changed from `draft` it may not be changed back to `draft`. You should keep this field to `draft` when the class is under development. A `draft` class cannot be used to create any object. You should set this field to `underReview` when you believe the class is ready for use. The platform will automatically set this field to `approved` and it can be immediately used to create or migrate objects. When updating an already `approved` class you should keep setting this field to `underReview`.|
|» securityAnimation|body|[SecurityAnimation](#schemasecurityanimation)|false|Optional information about the security animation. If this is set a security animation will be rendered on pass details.|
|» textModulesData|body|[[TextModuleData](#schematextmoduledata)]|false|Text module data. If text module data is also defined on the class, both will be displayed. The maximum number of these fields displayed is 10 from the object and 10 from the class.|
|» transitOperatorName|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|The name of the transit operator.|
|» transitType|body|string|false|Required. The type of transit this class represents, such as "bus".|
|» version|body|string(int64)|false|Deprecated|
|» viewUnlockRequirement|body|string|false|View Unlock Requirement options for the transit ticket.|
|» watermark|body|[Image](#schemaimage)|false|Watermark image to display on the user's device.|
|» wordMark|body|[Image](#schemaimage)|false|Deprecated.|

<h1 id="google-pay-passes-api-transitobject">transitobject</h1>

## walletobjects.transitobject.list

<a id="opIdwalletobjects.transitobject.list"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/walletobjects/v1/transitObject \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /walletobjects/v1/transitObject`

Returns a list of all transit objects for a given issuer ID.

<h3 id="walletobjectstransitobjectlist-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|classId|query|string|false|The ID of the class whose objects will be listed.|
|maxResults|query|integer|false|Identifies the max number of results returned by a list. All results are returned if `maxResults` isn't defined.|
|token|query|string|false|Used to get the next set of results if `maxResults` is specified, but more than `maxResults` objects are available in a list. For example, if you have a list of 200 objects and you call list with `maxResults` set to 20, list will return the first 20 objects and a token. Call list again with `maxResults` set to 20 and the token to get the next 20 objects.|
|$.xgafv|query|string|false|V1 error format.|
|access_token|query|string|false|OAuth access token.|
|alt|query|string|false|Data format for response.|
|callback|query|string|false|JSONP|
|fields|query|string|false|Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response.|
|key|query|string|false|API key. Your API key identifies your project and provides you with API access, quota, and reports. Required unless you provide an OAuth 2.0 token.|
|oauth_token|query|string|false|OAuth 2.0 token for the current user.|
|prettyPrint|query|boolean|false|Returns response with indentations and line breaks.|
|quotaUser|query|string|false|Available to use for quota purposes for server-side applications. Can be any arbitrary string assigned to a user, but should not exceed 40 characters.|
|upload_protocol|query|string|false|Upload protocol for media (e.g. "raw", "multipart").|
|uploadType|query|string|false|Legacy upload protocol for media (e.g. "media", "multipart").|

|Parameter|Value|

|$.xgafv|2|

<h3 id="walletobjectstransitobjectinsert-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|$.xgafv|query|string|false|V1 error format.|
|access_token|query|string|false|OAuth access token.|
|alt|query|string|false|Data format for response.|
|callback|query|string|false|JSONP|
|fields|query|string|false|Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response.|
|key|query|string|false|API key. Your API key identifies your project and provides you with API access, quota, and reports. Required unless you provide an OAuth 2.0 token.|
|oauth_token|query|string|false|OAuth 2.0 token for the current user.|
|prettyPrint|query|boolean|false|Returns response with indentations and line breaks.|
|quotaUser|query|string|false|Available to use for quota purposes for server-side applications. Can be any arbitrary string assigned to a user, but should not exceed 40 characters.|
|upload_protocol|query|string|false|Upload protocol for media (e.g. "raw", "multipart").|
|uploadType|query|string|false|Legacy upload protocol for media (e.g. "media", "multipart").|
|body|body|[TransitObject](#schematransitobject)|false|none|
|» activationStatus|body|[ActivationStatus](#schemaactivationstatus)|false|The activation status for the object. Required if the class has `activationOptions` set.|
|» appLinkData|body|[AppLinkData](#schemaapplinkdata)|false|Optional information about the partner app link.|
|» barcode|body|[Barcode](#schemabarcode)|false|The barcode type and value.|
|» classId|body|string|false|Required. The class associated with this object. The class must be of the same type as this object, must already exist, and must be approved. Class IDs should follow the format issuer ID.identifier where the former is issued by Google and latter is chosen by you.|
|» classReference|body|[TransitClass](#schematransitclass)|false|A copy of the inherited fields of the parent class. These fields are retrieved during a GET.|
|» concessionCategory|body|string|false|The concession category for the ticket.|
|» customConcessionCategory|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom concession category to use when `concessionCategory` does not provide the right option. Both `concessionCategory` and `customConcessionCategory` may not be set.|
|» customTicketStatus|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom status to use for the ticket status value when `ticketStatus` does not provide the right option. Both `ticketStatus` and `customTicketStatus` may not be set.|
|» deviceContext|body|[DeviceContext](#schemadevicecontext)|false|Device context associated with the object.|
|» disableExpirationNotification|body|boolean|false|Indicates if notifications should explicitly be suppressed. If this field is set to true, regardless of the `messages` field, expiration notifications to the user will be suppressed. By default, this field is set to false. Currently, this can only be set for offers.|
|» groupingInfo|body|[GroupingInfo](#schemagroupinginfo)|false|Information that controls how passes are grouped together.|
|» hasLinkedDevice|body|boolean|false|Whether this object is currently linked to a single device. This field is set by the platform when a user saves the object, linking it to their device. Intended for use by select partners. Contact support for additional information.|
|» hasUsers|body|boolean|false|Indicates if the object has users. This field is set by the platform.|
|» heroImage|body|[Image](#schemaimage)|false|Optional banner image displayed on the front of the card. If none is present, hero image of the class, if present, will be displayed. If hero image of the class is also not present, nothing will be displayed.|
|» hexBackgroundColor|body|string|false|The background color for the card. If not set the dominant color of the hero image is used, and if no hero image is set, the dominant color of the logo is used. The format is #rrggbb where rrggbb is a hex RGB triplet, such as `#ffcc00`. You can also use the shorthand version of the RGB triplet which is #rgb, such as `#fc0`.|
|» id|body|string|false|Required. The unique identifier for an object. This ID must be unique across all objects from an issuer. This value should follow the format issuer ID.identifier where the former is issued by Google and latter is chosen by you. The unique identifier should only include alphanumeric characters, '.', '_', or '-'.|
|» imageModulesData|body|[[ImageModuleData](#schemaimagemoduledata)]|false|Image module data. The maximum number of these fields displayed is 1 from object level and 1 for class object level.|
|» infoModuleData|body|[InfoModuleData](#schemainfomoduledata)|false|Deprecated. Use textModulesData instead.|
|» linksModuleData|body|[LinksModuleData](#schemalinksmoduledata)|false|Links module data. If links module data is also defined on the class, both will be displayed.|
|» locations|body|[[LatLongPoint](#schemalatlongpoint)]|false|Note: This field is currently not supported to trigger geo notifications.|
|» messages|body|[[Message](#schemamessage)]|false|An array of messages displayed in the app. All users of this object will receive its associated messages. The maximum number of these fields is 10.|
|» passConstraints|body|[PassConstraints](#schemapassconstraints)|false|Pass constraints for the object.|
|» passengerNames|body|string|false|The name(s) of the passengers the ticket is assigned to. The above `passengerType` field is meant to give Google context on this field.|
|» passengerType|body|string|false|The number of passengers.|
|» purchaseDetails|body|[PurchaseDetails](#schemapurchasedetails)|false|Purchase details for this ticket.|
|» rotatingBarcode|body|[RotatingBarcode](#schemarotatingbarcode)|false|The rotating barcode type and value.|
|» smartTapRedemptionValue|body|string|false|The value that will be transmitted to a Smart Tap certified terminal over NFC for this object. The class level fields `enableSmartTap` and `redemptionIssuers` must also be set up correctly in order for the pass to support Smart Tap. Only ASCII characters are supported.|
|» state|body|string|false|Required. The state of the object. This field is used to determine how an object is displayed in the app. For example, an `inactive` object is moved to the "Expired passes" section.|
|» textModulesData|body|[[TextModuleData](#schematextmoduledata)]|false|Text module data. If text module data is also defined on the class, both will be displayed. The maximum number of these fields displayed is 10 from the object and 10 from the class.|
|» ticketLeg|body|[TicketLeg](#schematicketleg)|false|A single ticket leg contains departure and arrival information along with boarding and seating information. If more than one leg is to be specified then use the `ticketLegs` field instead. Both `ticketLeg` and `ticketLegs` may not be set.|
|» ticketLegs|body|[[TicketLeg](#schematicketleg)]|false|Each ticket may contain one or more legs. Each leg contains departure and arrival information along with boarding and seating information. If only one leg is to be specified then use the `ticketLeg` field instead. Both `ticketLeg` and `ticketLegs` may not be set.|
|» ticketNumber|body|string|false|The number of the ticket. This is a unique identifier for the ticket in the transit operator's system.|
|» ticketRestrictions|body|[TicketRestrictions](#schematicketrestrictions)|false|Information about what kind of restrictions there are on using this ticket. For example, which days of the week it must be used, or which routes are allowed to be taken.|
|» ticketStatus|body|string|false|The status of the ticket. For states which affect display, use the `state` field instead.|
|» tripId|body|string|false|This id is used to group tickets together if the user has saved multiple tickets for the same trip.|
|» tripType|body|string|false|Required. The type of trip this transit object represents. Used to determine the pass title and/or which symbol to use between the origin and destination.|
|» validTimeInterval|body|[TimeInterval](#schematimeinterval)|false|The time period this object will be `active` and object can be used. An object's state will be changed to `expired` when this time period has passed.|
|» version|body|string(int64)|false|Deprecated|

## walletobjects.transitobject.get

<a id="opIdwalletobjects.transitobject.get"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/walletobjects/v1/transitObject/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /walletobjects/v1/transitObject/{resourceId}`

Returns the transit object with the given object ID.

<h3 id="walletobjectstransitobjectget-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|resourceId|path|string|true|The unique identifier for an object. This ID must be unique across all objects from an issuer. This value should follow the format issuer ID. identifier where the former is issued by Google and latter is chosen by you. Your unique identifier should only include alphanumeric characters, '.', '_', or '-'.|
|$.xgafv|query|string|false|V1 error format.|
|access_token|query|string|false|OAuth access token.|
|alt|query|string|false|Data format for response.|
|callback|query|string|false|JSONP|
|fields|query|string|false|Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response.|
|key|query|string|false|API key. Your API key identifies your project and provides you with API access, quota, and reports. Required unless you provide an OAuth 2.0 token.|
|oauth_token|query|string|false|OAuth 2.0 token for the current user.|
|prettyPrint|query|boolean|false|Returns response with indentations and line breaks.|
|quotaUser|query|string|false|Available to use for quota purposes for server-side applications. Can be any arbitrary string assigned to a user, but should not exceed 40 characters.|
|upload_protocol|query|string|false|Upload protocol for media (e.g. "raw", "multipart").|
|uploadType|query|string|false|Legacy upload protocol for media (e.g. "media", "multipart").|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|$.xgafv|1|
|$.xgafv|2|
|alt|json|
|alt|media|
|alt|proto|

{

<h3 id="walletobjectstransitobjectupdate-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|resourceId|path|string|true|The unique identifier for an object. This ID must be unique across all objects from an issuer. This value should follow the format issuer ID. identifier where the former is issued by Google and latter is chosen by you. Your unique identifier should only include alphanumeric characters, '.', '_', or '-'.|
|$.xgafv|query|string|false|V1 error format.|
|access_token|query|string|false|OAuth access token.|
|alt|query|string|false|Data format for response.|
|callback|query|string|false|JSONP|
|fields|query|string|false|Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response.|
|key|query|string|false|API key. Your API key identifies your project and provides you with API access, quota, and reports. Required unless you provide an OAuth 2.0 token.|
|oauth_token|query|string|false|OAuth 2.0 token for the current user.|
|prettyPrint|query|boolean|false|Returns response with indentations and line breaks.|
|quotaUser|query|string|false|Available to use for quota purposes for server-side applications. Can be any arbitrary string assigned to a user, but should not exceed 40 characters.|
|upload_protocol|query|string|false|Upload protocol for media (e.g. "raw", "multipart").|
|uploadType|query|string|false|Legacy upload protocol for media (e.g. "media", "multipart").|
|body|body|[TransitObject](#schematransitobject)|false|none|
|» activationStatus|body|[ActivationStatus](#schemaactivationstatus)|false|The activation status for the object. Required if the class has `activationOptions` set.|
|» appLinkData|body|[AppLinkData](#schemaapplinkdata)|false|Optional information about the partner app link.|
|» barcode|body|[Barcode](#schemabarcode)|false|The barcode type and value.|
|» classId|body|string|false|Required. The class associated with this object. The class must be of the same type as this object, must already exist, and must be approved. Class IDs should follow the format issuer ID.identifier where the former is issued by Google and latter is chosen by you.|
|» classReference|body|[TransitClass](#schematransitclass)|false|A copy of the inherited fields of the parent class. These fields are retrieved during a GET.|
|» concessionCategory|body|string|false|The concession category for the ticket.|
|» customConcessionCategory|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom concession category to use when `concessionCategory` does not provide the right option. Both `concessionCategory` and `customConcessionCategory` may not be set.|
|» customTicketStatus|body|[LocalizedString](#schemalocalizedstring)|false|A custom status to use for the ticket status value when `ticketStatus` does not provide the right option. Both `ticketStatus` and `customTicketStatus` may not be set.|
|» deviceContext|body|[DeviceContext](#schemadevicecontext)|false|Device context associated with the object.|
|» disableExpirationNotification|body|boolean|false|Indicates if notifications should explicitly be suppressed. If this field is set to true, regardless of the `messages` field, expiration notifications to the user will be suppressed. By default, this field is set to false. Currently, this can only be set for offers.|
|» groupingInfo|body|[GroupingInfo](#schemagroupinginfo)|false|Information that controls how passes are grouped together.|
|» hasLinkedDevice|body|boolean|false|Whether this object is currently linked to a single device. This field is set by the platform when a user saves the object, linking it to their device. Intended for use by select partners. Contact support for additional information.|
|» hasUsers|body|boolean|false|Indicates if the object has users. This field is set by the platform.|
|» heroImage|body|[Image](#schemaimage)|false|Optional banner image displayed on the front of the card. If none is present, hero image of the class, if present, will be displayed. If hero image of the class is also not present, nothing will be displayed.|
|» hexBackgroundColor|body|string|false|The background color for the card. If not set the dominant color of the hero image is used, and if no hero image is set, the dominant color of the logo is used. The format is #rrggbb where rrggbb is a hex RGB triplet, such as `#ffcc00`. You can also use the shorthand version of the RGB triplet which is #rgb, such as `#fc0`.|
|» id|body|string|false|Required. The unique identifier for an object. This ID must be unique across all objects from an issuer. This value should follow the format issuer ID.identifier where the former is issued by Google and latter is chosen by you. The unique identifier should only include alphanumeric characters, '.', '_', or '-'.|
|» imageModulesData|body|[[ImageModuleData](#schemaimagemoduledata)]|false|Image module data. The maximum number of these fields displayed is 1 from object level and 1 for class object level.|
|» infoModuleData|body|[InfoModuleData](#schemainfomoduledata)|false|Deprecated. Use textModulesData instead.|
|» linksModuleData|body|[LinksModuleData](#schemalinksmoduledata)|false|Links module data. If links module data is also defined on the class, both will be displayed.|
|» locations|body|[[LatLongPoint](#schemalatlongpoint)]|false|Note: This field is currently not supported to trigger geo notifications.|
|» messages|body|[[Message](#schemamessage)]|false|An array of messages displayed in the app. All users of this object will receive its associated messages. The maximum number of these fields is 10.|
|» passConstraints|body|[PassConstraints](#schemapassconstraints)|false|Pass constraints for the object.|
|» passengerNames|body|string|false|The name(s) of the passengers the ticket is assigned to. The above `passengerType` field is meant to give Google context on this field.|
|» passengerType|body|string|false|The number of passengers.|
|» purchaseDetails|body|[PurchaseDetails](#schemapurchasedetails)|false|Purchase details for this ticket.|
|» rotatingBarcode|body|[RotatingBarcode](#schemarotatingbarcode)|false|The rotating barcode type and value.|
|» smartTapRedemptionValue|body|string|false|The value that will be transmitted to a Smart Tap certified terminal over NFC for this object. The class level fields `enableSmartTap` and `redemptionIssuers` must also be set up correctly in order for the pass to support Smart Tap. Only ASCII characters are supported.|
|» state|body|string|false|Required. The state of the object. This field is used to determine how an object is displayed in the app. For example, an `inactive` object is moved to the "Expired passes" section.|
|» textModulesData|body|[[TextModuleData](#schematextmoduledata)]|false|Text module data. If text module data is also defined on the class, both will be displayed. The maximum number of these fields displayed is 10 from the object and 10 from the class.|
|» ticketLeg|body|[TicketLeg](#schematicketleg)|false|A single ticket leg contains departure and arrival information along with boarding and seating information. If more than one leg is to be specified then use the `ticketLegs` field instead. Both `ticketLeg` and `ticketLegs` may not be set.|
|» ticketLegs|body|[[TicketLeg](#schematicketleg)]|false|Each ticket may contain one or more legs. Each leg contains departure and arrival information along with boarding and seating information. If only one leg is to be specified then use the `ticketLeg` field instead. Both `ticketLeg` and `ticketLegs` may not be set.|
|» ticketNumber|body|string|false|The number of the ticket. This is a unique identifier for the ticket in the transit operator's system.|
|» ticketRestrictions|body|[TicketRestrictions](#schematicketrestrictions)|false|Information about what kind of restrictions there are on using this ticket. For example, which days of the week it must be used, or which routes are allowed to be taken.|
|» ticketStatus|body|string|false|The status of the ticket. For states which affect display, use the `state` field instead.|
|» tripId|body|string|false|This id is used to group tickets together if the user has saved multiple tickets for the same trip.|
|» tripType|body|string|false|Required. The type of trip this transit object represents. Used to determine the pass title and/or which symbol to use between the origin and destination.|
|» validTimeInterval|body|[TimeInterval](#schematimeinterval)|false|The time period this object will be `active` and object can be used. An object's state will be changed to `expired` when this time period has passed.|
|» version|body|string(int64)|false|Deprecated|

|resourceId|path|string|true|The unique identifier for an object. This ID must be unique across all objects from an issuer. Your unique identifier should only include alphanumeric characters, '.', '_', or '-'.|
|$.xgafv|query|string|false|V1 error format.|
|access_token|query|string|false|OAuth access token.|
|alt|query|string|false|Data format for response.|

|fields|query|string|false|Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response.|
